	PROCEDURE consultarmayor
		LParameters cCuenta
		Local cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH
		cId_CtaContable =Left(cCuenta,20)
		cId_Ejercicio   =ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value
		cId_Moneda      =ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		nTipoCotizacion =ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		dFechaD					=ThisForm.TbxFecD.Value
		dFechaH					=ThisForm.TbxFech.Value
		**ThisForm.RangoFecha(@dFechaD,@dFechaH)
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor")<>"0" 
		 	thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor","TG_ConsMayorContabilidad",cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH)
		Else
			thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor.Init(cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH)			
		Endif	
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters N
		local i,vDatos
		Dimension vDatos[1,4]
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntMovimientos","Tg_ViewCntMovimientos")	
		Thisform.AddObject("ocStSistemaContabilidad","tg_SistemaContabilidad")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_Tabla","Parametros","")
		ThisForm.ocStSistemaContabilidad.AsignarNivel(@vDatos,.T.)
		**
		** Guardo las opciones para mostrar el plan de cuenta
		**
		With ThisForm.CmbMostrarPlan
		   .Additem("Solo Plan de Cuentas    ")
		   .Additem("Plan de Cuentas y Saldos")
		EndWith   
		
		ThisForm.CmbMostrarPlan.ListitemId=1
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value=ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Id_Ejercicio")
		ThisForm.RefrescoTree=ThisForm.CmbMostrarPlan.value
		ThisForm.Tg_treeview1.MostrarDependecia(@vDatos,.F.)
		Dimension ThisForm.vMiVector[Alen(vDatos,1),4]
		ACopy(vDatos,ThisForm.vMiVector)
		ThisForm.Tg_treeview1.TreeView.Setfocus
		ThisForm.TbxFecD.value= CTod("  /  /  ")
		ThisForm.TbxFecH.value= CTod("  /  /  ")
		
		
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oapp.usuario) AND !EMPTY(thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie"))
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value = thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie")
		Else
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.SetearTodos()
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value="TD"
		ENDIF 
		
		** Seteo las propiedades old del form con los valores actuales de los combos
		ThisForm.OldCmbMostrarPlan=Thisform.CmbMostrarPlan.Value
		ThisForm.OldTg_CmbEjerciciosCont1=ThisForm.Tg_CmbEjerciciosCont1.value
		ThisForm.OldTg_CmbMonedas1=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.value
		ThisForm.OldTbxFecd=ThisForm.TbxFecd.value
		ThisForm.OldTbxFecH=ThisForm.TbxFecH.value
		ThisForm.OldMuestraRama=ThisForm.oChkMuestraRama.Value
		ThisForm.OldChkNegativos=ThisForm.oChkNegativos.Value
		ThisForm.OldoSpnNivel=ThisForm.oSpnNivel.Value
		Thisform.OldId_Categoria_TipoAs=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE rangofecha
		LParameters dFecD,dFecH
		Local dFecIni,dFecFin
		
		dFecIni=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		dFecFin=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		If Not Empty(dFecD) and Empty(dFech) 
			dFech=dFecD
		Endif
		If dFecd > dFech
			dFech=dFecd
		Endif 
		If Empty(dFech) 
			dFech=dFecFin
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecd)
			dFecd=DFecIni
		Endif
		
		If dFecd > DFecFin or dFecd < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.TbxFecD.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		If dFecH > DFecFin or dFecH < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.TbxFecH.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		
		
		
		Return .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		ThisForm.RefrescarConsulta()
		ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local i,Cmensaje,vDatos,nSaldo,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde
		Local dFech,dFecd,nOpcion,lModo
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		Dimension vDatos[Alen(ThisForm.vMiVector,1),4]
		Acopy(ThisForm.vMiVector,vDatos)
		Cmensaje=""
		i=0
		
		If Empty(thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda())
			cMensaje="Debe indicar la moneda con la cual se van a expresar los valores!"
		Endif
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value)
			cMensaje="Debe indicar el ejercicio contable a consultar!"
		Endif
		If !Empty(cMensaje)
			=fMensAceptar(Alltrim(cMensaje))
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Setfocus()
			Return .t.
		Endif
		dFecd=ThisForm.TbxFecD.Value
		dFech=ThisForm.TbxFech.Value
		If Not ThisForm.RangoFecha(@dFecD,@dFecH)
			Return 
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value="TD"
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=""
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		Else
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
		Endif
		
		
		
		ThisForm.Mousepointer=11
		
		nOpcion=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.value
		
		********* Martin
		This.oCstSistemaContabilidad.CalcularSaldosCuentas(@vDatos,ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value,thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),nOpcion,dFecD, dFecH,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde,cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta)
		
		*!*	For i = 1 to Alen(vDatos,1)
		*!*	 nSaldo=thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Refrescar(vDatos[i,1],ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value,thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),nOpcion,dFecD, dFecH)
		*!*	 vDatos[i,4]=nSaldo 
		*!*	Next
		Acopy(vDatos,ThisForm.vMiVector)
		If ThisForm.CmbMostrarPlan.ListItemId=2
			lModo=.T.
		Else
		  lModo=.f.
		Endif
		ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=.F.
		ThisForm.RefrescarTreeView(@vDatos,lModo)
		ThisForm.Mousepointer=0
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescartreeview
		LParameters vDatos, lSaldo
		Local cAbreviatura
		ThisForm.Tg_treeview1.MostrarDependecia(@vDatos,lSaldo,ThisForm.oChkMuestraRama.Value,ThisForm.oChkNegativos.Value,cAbreviatura,ThisForm.oSpnNivel.Value)
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE salir
		ThisForm.Release
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE CmbMostrarPlan.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldCmbMostrarPlan
		Endif	
		thisform.OldCmbMostrarPlan=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkMuestraRama.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldMuestraRama
		Endif	
		thisform.OldMuestraRama=this.Value
		ThisForm.oSpnNivel.Enabled=This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkNegativos.InteractiveChange

			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=This.Value<>ThisForm.OldChkNegativos
		Endif	
		ThisForm.OldChkNegativos=This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oSpnNivel.InteractiveChange

			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldoSpnNivel
		Endif	
		thisform.OldoSpnNivel=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TbxFecD.LostFocus
		If Not ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldTbxFecD
		Endif	
		thisform.OldTbxFecD=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TbxFech.LostFocus
		If Not ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldTbxFech
		Endif	
		thisform.OldTbxFech=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldTg_CmbEjercicioscont1
		Endif	
		thisform.OldTg_CmbEjercicioscont1=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If Not ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=This.Tg_CmbMonedas1.Value<>thisform.OldTg_Cmbmonedas1
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldTg_CmbMonedas1=This.Tg_CmbMonedas1.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_treeview1.TreeView.DblClick
		*** Evento de control OLE ***
		If Not Empty(ThisForm.NodoCta)
			ThisForm.ConsultarMayor(ThisForm.NodoCta)
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_treeview1.TreeView.NodeClick
		*** Evento de control OLE ***
		LPARAMETERS node
		If Node.Children = 0 
			ThisForm.NodoCta=Node.Text
		Else
			ThisForm.NodoCta=""	
		Endif	
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters Opcion
		dodefault() 
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblCtasContables","Tg_Tabla","CtasContables","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros","")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntSumasSaldos","Tg_ViewCntSumasSaldos")
		
		thisform.Recno=1
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value=ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Id_Ejercicio")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFecd.Value=Ctod(" / / ")
		ThisForm.oTbxFecH.Value=Ctod(" / / ")
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.Value="TD"
		
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oapp.usuario) AND !EMPTY(thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie"))
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value = thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie")
		Else
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.SetearTodos()
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value="TD"
		ENDIF 
		
		ThisForm.Oldcmbcategoria_cuentas1=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.Value
		ThisForm.OldTg_CmbEjerciciosCont1=ThisForm.Tg_CmbEjerciciosCont1.value
		ThisForm.OldTg_CmbMonedas1=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.value
		ThisForm.Old_oTbxFecd=ThisForm.oTbxFecd.value
		ThisForm.Old_oTbxFecH=ThisForm.oTbxFecH.value
		Thisform.OldId_Categoria_TipoAs=ThisForm.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(3,4)
		*!*	ThisForm.RefrescarConsulta(.T.)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		LParameters cCuenta
		Local cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH
		cId_CtaContable =cCuenta
		cId_Ejercicio   =ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value
		cId_Moneda      =ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		nTipoCotizacion =ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		dFechaD					=ThisForm.oTbxFecD.Value
		dFechaH					=ThisForm.oTbxFech.Value
		
		If Type("Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>"0" 
		 	thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsMayorContabilidad",cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH)
		Else
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Init(cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH)			
		Endif	
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.t.)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters lMoverFocus
		Local dFecD,dFecH,nOpcion,dFecIni,dFecFin
		Local cId_CategoriaDesde,cId_CategoriaHasta,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		
		dFecD=ThisForm.oTbxFecd.Value
		dFecH=ThisForm.oTbxFecH.Value
		dFecIni=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		dFecFin=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		If Not Empty(dFecD) And Empty(dFecH)
			dFecH=dFecD
		Endif
		If dFecd > dFecH
			dFecH=dFecd
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecH)
			dFech=dFecFin
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecD)
			dFecD=dFecIni
		Endif
		
		
		If dFecd > DFecFin or dFecd < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.oTbxFecd.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		If dFecH > DFecFin or dFecH < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.oTbxFecH.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		
		
		nOpcion=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.value
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		IF Upper(ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.Value)="TD"
			cId_CategoriaDesde=""
			cId_CategoriaHasta=oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		Else
			cId_CategoriaDesde=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.Value
			cId_CategoriaHasta=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.Value
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value="TD"
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=""
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		Else
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
		Endif
		
		Thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Refrescar(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value,thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),nOpcion,dFecD, dFecH,cId_CategoriaDesde,cId_CategoriaHasta,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde,cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.IrPrimero()
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla(lMoverFocus)		
		ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=.F.
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		lParameters lLlevaFocoAGrilla
		Local mmpp
		
		** Parametro intocable porque a veces no puedo hacer el setfocus cuando se hace
		** un refrescarAplicacion desde otro objeto, este no puede tomar el foco sino
		** se lo debe dejar al otro objeto sin quitarselo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource						=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias+".Id_CtaContable"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias+".nDebe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias+".nHaber"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias+".nSaldo"
		
		** SERGIO 02/05/2023 # 1603
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.InputMask	=	"999,999,999,999.99"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.InputMask	=	"999,999,999,999.99"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.InputMask	=	"999,999,999,999.99"
		** SERGIO 02/05/2023 # 1603
		
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.IrUltimo
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		For mmpp=1 to 11-ThisForm.FilaGrillaRelativa
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(0)
		EndFor
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(ThisForm.tg_grid1.RelativeRow,8)
		
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFecd.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=ThisForm.oTbxFecd.Value<>thisform.Old_oTbxFecd
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.Old_OTbxFecd=Thisform.oTbxFecd.Value
	ENDPROC

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_presentamoneda1' AS tg_presentamoneda WITH ;
		Height = 46, ;
		Left = 10, ;
		Name = "Tg_presentamoneda1", ;
		TabIndex = 11, ;
		Top = 91, ;
		Width = 338, ;
		ZOrderSet = 4, ;
		Tg_cmbmonedas1.Height = 21, ;
		Tg_cmbmonedas1.Left = 110, ;
		Tg_cmbmonedas1.Name = "Tg_cmbmonedas1", ;
		Tg_cmbmonedas1.Top = 0, ;
		Tg_cmbmonedas1.Width = 215, ;
		Tg_label1.FontBold = .F., ;
		Tg_label1.Name = "Tg_label1", ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Left = 105, ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Name = "oOpgTipoCotizacion", ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option1.Left = 5, ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option1.Name = "Option1", ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option1.Top = 5, ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option2.Left = 84, ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option2.Name = "Option2", ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Option2.Top = 5, ;
		oOpgTipoCotizacion.Top = 25, ;
		Tg_label2.FontBold = .F., ;
		Tg_label2.Name = "Tg_label2"
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_varios.vcx" BaseClass="container" />
	
	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters Opcion
		dodefault() 
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblCtasContables","Tg_Tabla","CtasContables","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros","")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntSumasSaldos","Tg_ViewCntSumasSaldos")
		
		thisform.Recno=1
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value=ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Id_Ejercicio")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFecd.Value=Ctod(" / / ")
		ThisForm.oTbxFecH.Value=Ctod(" / / ")
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.SetearTodos()
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.Value="TD"
		
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oapp.usuario) AND !EMPTY(thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie"))
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value = thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie")
		Else
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.SetearTodos()
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value="TD"
		ENDIF 
		
		ThisForm.Oldcmbcategoria_cuentas1=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.Value
		ThisForm.OldTg_CmbEjerciciosCont1=ThisForm.Tg_CmbEjerciciosCont1.value
		ThisForm.OldTg_CmbMonedas1=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.value
		ThisForm.Old_oTbxFecd=ThisForm.oTbxFecd.value
		ThisForm.Old_oTbxFecH=ThisForm.oTbxFecH.value
		Thisform.OldId_Categoria_TipoAs=ThisForm.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(3,4)
		*!*	ThisForm.RefrescarConsulta(.T.)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		LParameters cCuenta
		Local cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH
		cId_CtaContable =cCuenta
		cId_Ejercicio   =ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value
		cId_Moneda      =ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		nTipoCotizacion =ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		dFechaD					=ThisForm.oTbxFecD.Value
		dFechaH					=ThisForm.oTbxFech.Value
		
		If Type("Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>"0" 
		 	thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsMayorContabilidad",cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH)
		Else
			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Init(cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH)			
		Endif	
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.t.)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters lMoverFocus
		Local dFecD,dFecH,nOpcion,dFecIni,dFecFin
		Local cId_CategoriaDesde,cId_CategoriaHasta,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		
		dFecD=ThisForm.oTbxFecd.Value
		dFecH=ThisForm.oTbxFecH.Value
		dFecIni=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		dFecFin=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		If Not Empty(dFecD) And Empty(dFecH)
			dFecH=dFecD
		Endif
		If dFecd > dFecH
			dFecH=dFecd
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecH)
			dFech=dFecFin
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecD)
			dFecD=dFecIni
		Endif
		
		
		If dFecd > DFecFin or dFecd < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.oTbxFecd.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		If dFecH > DFecFin or dFecH < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.oTbxFecH.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		
		
		nOpcion=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.value
		thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		IF Upper(ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.Value)="TD"
			cId_CategoriaDesde=""
			cId_CategoriaHasta=oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		Else
			cId_CategoriaDesde=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.Value
			cId_CategoriaHasta=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.Value
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value="TD"
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=""
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		Else
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
		Endif
		
		Thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Refrescar(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value,thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),nOpcion,dFecD, dFecH,cId_CategoriaDesde,cId_CategoriaHasta,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde,cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.IrPrimero()
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla(lMoverFocus)		
		ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=.F.
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		lParameters lLlevaFocoAGrilla
		Local mmpp
		
		** Parametro intocable porque a veces no puedo hacer el setfocus cuando se hace
		** un refrescarAplicacion desde otro objeto, este no puede tomar el foco sino
		** se lo debe dejar al otro objeto sin quitarselo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource						=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias+".Id_CtaContable"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias+".Nombre"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias+".nDebe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias+".nHaber"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.Alias+".nSaldo"
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		thisform.oViewCntSumasSaldos.IrUltimo
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		For mmpp=1 to 11-ThisForm.FilaGrillaRelativa
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(0)
		EndFor
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(ThisForm.tg_grid1.RelativeRow,8)
		
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFecd.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=ThisForm.oTbxFecd.Value<>thisform.Old_oTbxFecd
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.Old_OTbxFecd=Thisform.oTbxFecd.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFecH.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled
			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=ThisForm.oTbxFecH.Value<>Thisform.Old_oTbxFecH
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.Old_OTbxFecH=Thisform.oTbxFecH.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnAplicar.Click

		ThisForm.RefrescarConsulta(.T.)
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcategoria_cuentas1.InteractiveChange

			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=This.Value<>thisform.OldCmbCategoria_Cuentas1

	ENDPROC

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		thisform.FilaGrillaRelativa=this.RelativeRow
		thisform.FilaGrillaAbsoluta=this.ActiveRow
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.DblClick

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda

	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange

			ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled=This.Tg_Cmbmonedas1.Value<>thisform.OldTg_Cmbmonedas1
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.Tg_btnAplicar.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldTg_CmbMonedas1=This.Tg_CmbMonedas1.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutar
		Local dFecD,dFecH,lOpcion,vSaldos,i,vDatos[1,2],nSaldo
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		dFecD = ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value 
		dFecH = ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value 
		
		If Empty(dFecH)
			dFecH = oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		endif
		
		lOpcion = iif(ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value = 1,.t.,.f.)
		
		ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value = Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Refrescar(ThisForm.Tg_centrocostos1.Value,dFecD,dFecH,thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),lOpcion,@vSaldos)
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Revertir()
		
		If Type("vSaldos") <> "L"
			nSaldo = 0
			For i= 1 to Alen(vSaldos,1)
				
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Id_CtaContable", vSaldos[i,1] )
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Nombre"		 , vSaldos[i,2] )
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Id_CCosto"	 , ThisForm.Tg_centrocostos1.Value )
				
				nSaldo = nSaldo + vSaldos[i,3]
				If vSaldos[i,3] > 0
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpDebe",  vSaldos[i,3] )
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpHaber", 0 )
				Else
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpDebe",  0 )
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpHaber", vSaldos[i,3] )
				Endif
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpSaldo", nSaldo )
						
				Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
			Next
		Endif
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.IrPrimero()
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled = .f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled = .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCentroCostos","Tg_tabla","CentroCostos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros","")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntCentrosCostos","Tg_ViewCntCentrosCostos")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos","Tg_tabla","Aux_CntCentrosCostos")
		
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value = Ctod(Space(8))
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value = Ctod(Space(8))
		
		thisform.OldId_CCosto=ThisForm.Tg_centrocostos1.Value
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value 
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion=thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(3,4)
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrardistribucion
		Local dFecD,dFecH,lOpcion,cId_Moneda,cId_CCosto,cId_CtaContable
		
		dFecD = ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value 
		dFecH = ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value 
		
		If Empty(dFecH)
			dFecH = oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		Endif
		
		cId_Moneda = ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		lOpcion = iif(ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value = 1,.t.,.f.)
		cId_CCosto = Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Leer("Id_CCosto")
		cId_CtaContable = Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Leer("Id_CtaContable")
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos","Tg_ConsultaCentroCostos",cId_CCosto,cId_CtaContable,dFecd,dFecH,cId_Moneda,lOpcion,.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos.Consultar(cId_CCosto,cId_CtaContable,dFecd,dFecH,cId_Moneda,lOpcion,.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos.Show()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ponernombre
		LParameters cId_CCosto
		
		If !Empty(cId_CCosto)
		
			If Thisform.oTblCentroCostos.Buscar(cId_CCosto,.f.,"Clave")
				ThisForm.oTbxNomCentroCosto.Value = Thisform.oTblCentroCostos.Leer("Nombre")
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled= cId_CCosto <> thisform.OldId_CCosto
				thisform.OldId_CCosto =cId_CCosto
			Else
				=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar un centro de costo existente!")	
				thisform.OldId_CCosto =Space(3)
				ThisForm.Tg_centrocostos1.Value = Space(3)
				ThisForm.oTbxNomCentroCosto.Value = Space(3)
				ThisForm.Tg_centrocostos1.SetFocus()
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=.f.
			Endif
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		Thisform.Ejecutar()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.LockScreen = .t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Id_CtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Nombre"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".ImpDebe"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".ImpHaber"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".ImpSaldo"
		
		** SERGIO 02/05/2023 # 1603
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		** SERGIO 02/05/2023 # 1603
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		Thisform.LockScreen = .f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		Thisform.Release
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutar.Click
		Thisform.Ejecutar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldFechaDesde=This.Value	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldFechaHasta=This.Value	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		Dimension this.vTitulos [2,2]
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Asiento : "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = Alltrim(ThisForm.oTbxNombreAsiento.Value ) 
		
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Numero : "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = Str(ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value,10)
		
		DoDefault()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_centrocostos1.LostFocus
		Thisform.PonerNombre(This.Value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_centrocostos1.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		Thisform.MostrarDistribucion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Tg_Cmbmonedas1.Value<>thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion  .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion=This.Tg_CmbMonedas1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		*< END OBJECT: BaseClass="textbox" />

	PROCEDURE ejecutar
		Local dFecD,dFecH,lOpcion,vSaldos,i,vDatos[1,2],nSaldo
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.SetearCursorEspera()
		
		dFecD = ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value 
		dFecH = ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value 
		
		If Empty(dFecH)
			dFecH = oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		endif
		
		lOpcion = iif(ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value = 1,.t.,.f.)
		
		ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value = Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Refrescar(ThisForm.Tg_centrocostos1.Value,dFecD,dFecH,thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),lOpcion,@vSaldos)
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Revertir()
		
		If Type("vSaldos") <> "L"
			nSaldo = 0
			For i= 1 to Alen(vSaldos,1)
				
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Id_CtaContable", vSaldos[i,1] )
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Nombre"		 , vSaldos[i,2] )
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"Id_CCosto"	 , ThisForm.Tg_centrocostos1.Value )
				
				nSaldo = nSaldo + vSaldos[i,3]
				If vSaldos[i,3] > 0
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpDebe",  vSaldos[i,3] )
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpHaber", 0 )
				Else
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpDebe",  0 )
					=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpHaber", vSaldos[i,3] )
				Endif
				=fGrabar(@vDatos,"ImpSaldo", nSaldo )
						
				Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.AgregaryModificar(@vDatos,.t.)
			Next
		Endif
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.IrPrimero()
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera()
		
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled = .f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled = .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCentroCostos","Tg_tabla","CentroCostos","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros","")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntCentrosCostos","Tg_ViewCntCentrosCostos")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos","Tg_tabla","Aux_CntCentrosCostos")
		
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		
		Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.SetearProp("BOT")
		
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value = Ctod(Space(8))
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value = Ctod(Space(8))
		
		thisform.OldId_CCosto=ThisForm.Tg_centrocostos1.Value
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value 
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion=thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(3,4)
		
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrardistribucion
		Local dFecD,dFecH,lOpcion,cId_Moneda,cId_CCosto,cId_CtaContable
		
		dFecD = ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value 
		dFecH = ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value 
		
		If Empty(dFecH)
			dFecH = oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		Endif
		
		cId_Moneda = ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		lOpcion = iif(ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value = 1,.t.,.f.)
		cId_CCosto = Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Leer("Id_CCosto")
		cId_CtaContable = Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Leer("Id_CtaContable")
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos","Tg_ConsultaCentroCostos",cId_CCosto,cId_CtaContable,dFecd,dFecH,cId_Moneda,lOpcion,.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos.Consultar(cId_CCosto,cId_CtaContable,dFecd,dFecH,cId_Moneda,lOpcion,.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos.Show()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ponernombre
		LParameters cId_CCosto
		
		If !Empty(cId_CCosto)
		
			If Thisform.oTblCentroCostos.Buscar(cId_CCosto,.f.,"Clave")
				ThisForm.oTbxNomCentroCosto.Value = Thisform.oTblCentroCostos.Leer("Nombre")
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled= cId_CCosto <> thisform.OldId_CCosto
				thisform.OldId_CCosto =cId_CCosto
			Else
				=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar un centro de costo existente!")	
				thisform.OldId_CCosto =Space(3)
				ThisForm.Tg_centrocostos1.Value = Space(3)
				ThisForm.oTbxNomCentroCosto.Value = Space(3)
				ThisForm.Tg_centrocostos1.SetFocus()
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=.f.
			Endif
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		Thisform.Ejecutar()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.LockScreen = .t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Id_CtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Nombre"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".ImpDebe"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".ImpHaber"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=Thisform.oTblAux_CntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".ImpSaldo"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		Thisform.LockScreen = .f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		Thisform.Release
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutar.Click
		Thisform.Ejecutar
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldFechaDesde=This.Value	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldFechaHasta=This.Value	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		Dimension this.vTitulos [2,2]
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Asiento : "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = Alltrim(ThisForm.oTbxNombreAsiento.Value ) 
		
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Numero : "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = Str(ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value,10)
		
		DoDefault()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_centrocostos1.LostFocus
		Thisform.PonerNombre(This.Value)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_centrocostos1.Valid
		LPARAMETERS lanulamensaje
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		Thisform.MostrarDistribucion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Tg_Cmbmonedas1.Value<>thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion  .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion=This.Tg_CmbMonedas1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE consultar
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.Caption =thisform.Caption + "  Sistema: "+cId_Sistema+" Comprobante: " + cId_Comproba + "  " + "Referencia: "+alltrim(str(nNro_Referencia))
		
		Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia
		
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos","tg_viewcntcmpcentroscostos")
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
		Thisform.Consultar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If !thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		Thisform.LockScreen = .t.

		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Id_CCosto"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".NomCentroCostos"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Id_CtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".NomCtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Porcentaje"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Importe"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".cFijo"

		Thisform.LockScreen = .f.
		
	ENDPROC

DEFINE CLASS tg_conscmpcentrocostos_08_05_2023 AS tg_formdlg OF "tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="form" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	*-- OBJECTDATA items order determines ZOrder / El orden de los items OBJECTDATA determina el ZOrder 
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_3dshape1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_btnaceptar1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1.Column1.Header1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />
	*< OBJECTDATA: ObjPath="Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1" UniqueID="" Timestamp="" />

	PROCEDURE consultar
		lParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		thisform.Caption =thisform.Caption + "  Sistema: "+cId_Sistema+" Comprobante: " + cId_Comproba + "  " + "Referencia: "+alltrim(str(nNro_Referencia))
		
		Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia
		
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos","tg_viewcntcmpcentroscostos")
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
		Thisform.Consultar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If !thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		Thisform.LockScreen = .t.
		
		Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.IrPrimero()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType= 1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Id_CCosto"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".NomCentroCostos"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Id_CtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".NomCtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Porcentaje"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Importe"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewCntCmpCentrosCostos.Alias + ".cFijo"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen = .f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		Thisform.Hide
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantes","Tg_ViewComprobantesContabilidad")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Ejercicio=thisform.Tg_CmbEjerciciosCont1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldSoloNoBalanceados=.f.
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.CurrentControl="oCmdSubDiario"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.Sparse=.f.
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","tg_compconsultaasientos",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarsubdiario
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario","Tg_ConsSubDiarioContable",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario.Consultar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Ejercicio,lAnulado,lSoloNoBalanceados,dFecIni,dFecFin,dFecD,dFecH
		thisform.SEtearCursorEspera
		
		dFecD=ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		dFecH=ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		dFecIni=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		dFecFin=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		
		If Not Empty(dFecD) And Empty(dFecH)
			dFecH=dFecD
		Endif
		If dFecd > dFecH
			dFecH=dFecd
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecH)
			dFech=dFecFin
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecD)
			dFecD=dFecIni
		Endif
		
		
		If (dFecd > DFecFin or dFecd < dFecIni) And ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value <> "TD"
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		If (dFecH > DFecFin or dFecH < dFecIni) And ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value <> "TD"
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.Value="TD"
			cId_Ejercicio=""
		Else
			cId_Ejercicio=ThisForm.Tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.Value
		Endif
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		lSoloNoBalanceados=ThisForm.oChkSoloNoBalanceado.Value
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescontabilidad1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,cId_Ejercicio,dFecD,dFecH,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),lSoloNoBalanceados)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSEtearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".NombreComprobante"
		** Matias L. 22/05/2023 #1624
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".detalle"
		** Matias L. 22/05/2023 #1624
		
		
		
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Sumar("Saldo",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkSoloNoBalanceado.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldSoloNoBalanceados
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldSoloNoBalanceados=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgAnulado.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Ejercicio
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Ejercicio=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column8.oCmdSubDiario.Click
		Thisform.MostrarSubDiario()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescontabilidad1.Init
		dodefault(".t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescontabilidad1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantes","Tg_ViewComprobantesContabilidad")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Ejercicio=thisform.Tg_CmbEjerciciosCont1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldSoloNoBalanceados=.f.
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.CurrentControl="oCmdSubDiario"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.Sparse=.f.
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","tg_compconsultaasientos",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarsubdiario
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario","Tg_ConsSubDiarioContable",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario.Consultar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Ejercicio,lAnulado,lSoloNoBalanceados,dFecIni,dFecFin,dFecD,dFecH
		thisform.SEtearCursorEspera
		
		dFecD=ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		dFecH=ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		dFecIni=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		dFecFin=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		
		If Not Empty(dFecD) And Empty(dFecH)
			dFecH=dFecD
		Endif
		If dFecd > dFecH
			dFecH=dFecd
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecH)
			dFech=dFecFin
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecD)
			dFecD=dFecIni
		Endif
		
		
		If (dFecd > DFecFin or dFecd < dFecIni) And ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value <> "TD"
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		If (dFecH > DFecFin or dFecH < dFecIni) And ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value <> "TD"
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.Value="TD"
			cId_Ejercicio=""
		Else
			cId_Ejercicio=ThisForm.Tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.Value
		Endif
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		lSoloNoBalanceados=ThisForm.oChkSoloNoBalanceado.Value
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescontabilidad1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,cId_Ejercicio,dFecD,dFecH,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),lSoloNoBalanceados)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSEtearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".NombreComprobante"
		
		
		** SERGIO 03/05/2023 # 1603
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		** SERGIO 03/05/2023 # 1603
		
		** Matias L. 22/05/2023 #1624
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".detalle"
		** Matias L. 22/05/2023 #1624
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Sumar("Saldo",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkSoloNoBalanceado.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldSoloNoBalanceados
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldSoloNoBalanceados=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgAnulado.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Ejercicio
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Ejercicio=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column8.oCmdSubDiario.Click
		Thisform.MostrarSubDiario()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescontabilidad1.Init
		dodefault(".t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescontabilidad1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE ejecutarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		
		dodefault()
		thisform.SetearHelpConTextId("Consulta")
		thisform.AddObject("oViewComprobantes","Tg_ViewComprobantesContabilidad")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","tg_tabla","Monedas","clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		
		thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		thisform.tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.SetearTodos()
		thisform.tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.Value="TD"
		
		Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value=cTod("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		thisform.OldId_moneda=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldId_Ejercicio=thisform.Tg_CmbEjerciciosCont1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		thisform.OldSoloNoBalanceados=.f.
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.CurrentControl="oCmdSubDiario"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.Sparse=.f.
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","tg_compconsultaasientos",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarsubdiario
		Local cTexto,oLst
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario","Tg_ConsSubDiarioContable",thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario.Consultar(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewComprobantes.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaSubDiario.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		Local cId_Ejercicio,lAnulado,lSoloNoBalanceados,dFecIni,dFecFin,dFecD,dFecH
		thisform.SEtearCursorEspera
		
		dFecD=ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.Value
		dFecH=ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.Value
		
		dFecIni=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		dFecFin=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		
		If Not Empty(dFecD) And Empty(dFecH)
			dFecH=dFecD
		Endif
		If dFecd > dFecH
			dFecH=dFecd
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecH)
			dFech=dFecFin
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecD)
			dFecD=dFecIni
		Endif
		
		
		If (dFecd > DFecFin or dFecd < dFecIni) And ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value <> "TD"
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.oTbxFechaDesde.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		If (dFecH > DFecFin or dFecH < dFecIni) And ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value <> "TD"
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.oTbxFechaHasta.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.Value="TD"
			cId_Ejercicio=""
		Else
			cId_Ejercicio=ThisForm.Tg_cmbEjerciciosCont1.Value
		Endif
		lAnulado=(thisform.oOpgAnulado.Value=2)
		lSoloNoBalanceados=ThisForm.oChkSoloNoBalanceado.Value
		
		=aCopy(ThisForm.Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescontabilidad1.vItems,vComprobantes)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.oViewComprobantes.Refrescar(@vComprobantes,cId_Ejercicio,dFecD,dFecH,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),lAnulado,ThisForm.tg_PresentaMoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion(),lSoloNoBalanceados)
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.RefrescarGrilla
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.LockScreen=.f.	
		thisform.DesSEtearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Nro_externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=thisform.oViewComprobantes.Alias+".NombreComprobante"
		
		
		
		
		
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		thisform.oTbxTotal.Value=Round(thisform.oViewComprobantes.Sumar("Saldo",".t."),2)
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oChkSoloNoBalanceado.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldSoloNoBalanceados
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldSoloNoBalanceados=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oOpgAnulado.InteractiveChange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_BtnImprimirGrilla1.Enabled=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaDesde.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled	
		Endif
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=this.Value
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaHasta.LostFocus
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=this.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.InteractiveChange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_Ejercicio
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Ejercicio=this.Value
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column8.oCmdSubDiario.Click
		Thisform.MostrarSubDiario()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If !ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			If this.ConsultarMoneda()<>thisform.OldId_Moneda .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=.t.
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled			
			Endif	
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Moneda=this.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescontabilidad1.Init
		dodefault(".t.",.t.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_seleccionarcomprobantescontabilidad1.interactivechange
		ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.ExistenMarcados()
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_CtaContable,cID_Ejercicio,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH
		dodefault()
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblCtasContables","Tg_Tabla","CtasContables","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros","")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntMovimientos","Tg_ViewCntMovimientos")	
		Thisform.AddObject("ocStSistemaContabilidad","tg_SistemaContabilidad")
		thisform.Recno=1
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value=ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Id_Ejercicio")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias
		
		ThisForm.TbxFecD.Value=Ctod(" / / ")
		ThisForm.TbxFecH.Value=Ctod(" / / ")
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(7,8)
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDAEXISTENCIA 
		If Type("cId_CtaContable")<>T_LOGICAL
			ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Value=cId_CtaContable
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
		*!*		ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Valid
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.LostFocus
			ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Enabled=.f.
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value= cId_Ejercicio
			ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.value    =	cId_MonedaPresentacion
			ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value=	nTipoCotizacion
			
			******* Martin
			If Empty(dFechaD)
				dFechaD=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)
			Endif
			If Empty(dFechaH)
				dFechaH=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)				
			Endif
			***
			
			ThisForm.TbxFecD.Value=	dFechaD
			ThisForm.TbxFecH.Value= dFechaH
			ThisForm.Tg_CtasContables1.Valid
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.enabled=.f.	
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.	
			thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.t.)
		Endif
		
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oapp.usuario) AND !EMPTY(thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie"))
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value = thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie")
		Else
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.SetearTodos()
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value="TD"
		ENDIF 
		
		thisform.OldId_CtaContable=ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Ejercicio=ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value
		Thisform.OldId_Categoria_TipoAs=ThisForm.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=ThisForm.TbxFecD.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=ThisForm.TbxFech.Value
		thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion=thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","tg_compconsultaasientos",thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarsubdiario
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.f.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters lMoverFocus
		Local nOpcion,dFecD,dFecH,dFecIni,dFecFin,lRetorna,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		dFecD=ThisForm.TbxFecD.Value
		dFecH=ThisForm.TbxFecH.Value
		
		dFecIni=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		dFecFin=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		
		
		If dFecd > dFecH
			dFecH=dFecd
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecH)
			dFech=dFecFin
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecD)
			dFecD=dFecIni
		Endif
		
		lRetorna=.t.
		
		If dFecd > DFecFin or dFecd < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.TbxFecD.SetFocus()
			lRetorna=.f.
		
		Endif
		If dFecH > DFecFin or dFecH < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.TbxFech.SetFocus()
			lRetorna=.f.
		
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value="TD"
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=""
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		Else
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
		Endif
		
		If lRetorna
		
			nOpcion=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.value
			thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
			Thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Refrescar(ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value,thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),nOpcion,dFecD, dFecH,,,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde,cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias
				
			thisform.RefrescarGrilla(lMoverFocus)		
		Endif	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		lParameters lLlevaFocoAGrilla
		
		
		** Parametro intocable porque a veces no puedo hacer el setfocus cuando se hace
		** un refrescarAplicacion desde otro objeto, este no puede tomar el foco sino
		** se lo debe dejar al otro objeto sin quitarselo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource						=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".ImpDebe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".ImpHaber"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Saldo"
		
		** SERGIO 02/05/2023 # 1603
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.InputMask	=	"999,999,999,999.99"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.InputMask	=	"999,999,999,999.99"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.InputMask	=	"999,999,999,999.99"
		** SERGIO 02/05/2023 # 1603
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		*!*	If lLlevaFocoAGrilla
		*!*		thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
		*!*		thisform.CtaValidada=.f.  && Este setfocus produce otro valid del cliente
		*!*	Endif							  && Pongo este flag para que no cargue la vista de nuevo
		
		thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.IrUltimo
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		For mmpp=1 to 11-ThisForm.FilaGrillaRelativa
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(0)
		EndFor
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(ThisForm.tg_grid1.RelativeRow,8)
		
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDatosCuenta.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","CTasContables",.f.,ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Value)
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TbxFecD.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=ThisForm.TbxFecd.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.TbxFecd.Value	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TbxFecH.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=ThisForm.TbxFech.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.TbxFech.Value	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value<>thisform.OldId_Categoria_TipoAs
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(this.Value)
		Thisform.oLblNombreContable.Caption= thisform.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		
		If nKeyCode = 13 
			thisform.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(this.Value)
			Thisform.oLblNombreContable.Caption= thisform.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre")
		Endif
		
		dodefault(nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.LostFocus
		If !this.FormDesactivado And Thisform.CtaValidada
			If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_CtaContable
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
			Endif	
			Thisform.OldId_CtaContable=this.Value
		
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.ProgrammaticChange
		thisform.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(this.Value)
		Thisform.oLblNombreContable.Caption= thisform.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado.and.!thisform.CtaValidada
				thisform.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(this.Value)
				Thisform.oLblNombreContable.Caption= thisform.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre")
				thisform.CtaValidada=.t.
		endif
		If (thisform.CtaValidada.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.oCmdDatosCuenta.Enabled=.t.
		Else
			Thisform.oLblNombreContable.Caption= Space(10)
			thisform.oCmdDatosCuenta.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		thisform.FilaGrillaRelativa=this.RelativeRow
		thisform.FilaGrillaAbsoluta=this.ActiveRow
		
	ENDPROC

			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=This.Tg_Cmbmonedas1.Value<>thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion  .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion

		Endif	
		Thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion=This.Tg_CmbMonedas1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC
