	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cId_CtaContable,cID_Ejercicio,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH
		dodefault()
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblCtasContables","Tg_Tabla","CtasContables","Clave")
		thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","tg_tabla","Parametros","")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntMovimientos","Tg_ViewCntMovimientos")	
		Thisform.AddObject("ocStSistemaContabilidad","tg_SistemaContabilidad")
		thisform.Recno=1
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.AsignarMonedaDefault(thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def"))
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value=ThisForm.oTblParametros.Leer("Id_Ejercicio")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias
		
		ThisForm.TbxFecD.Value=Ctod(" / / ")
		ThisForm.TbxFecH.Value=Ctod(" / / ")
		
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(7,8)
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Valida=TG_TC_VALIDAEXISTENCIA 
		If Type("cId_CtaContable")<>T_LOGICAL
			ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Value=cId_CtaContable
			thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
		*!*		ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Valid
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.LostFocus
			ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Enabled=.f.
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value= cId_Ejercicio
			ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.value    =	cId_MonedaPresentacion
			ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value=	nTipoCotizacion
			
			******* Martin
			If Empty(dFechaD)
				dFechaD=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)
			Endif
			If Empty(dFechaH)
				dFechaH=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)				
			Endif
			***
			
			ThisForm.TbxFecD.Value=	dFechaD
			ThisForm.TbxFecH.Value= dFechaH
			ThisForm.Tg_CtasContables1.Valid
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.enabled=.f.	
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.	
			thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.t.)
		Endif
		
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oapp.usuario) AND !EMPTY(thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie"))
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value = thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie")
		Else
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.SetearTodos()
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value="TD"
		ENDIF 
		
		thisform.OldId_CtaContable=ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Value
		thisform.OldId_Ejercicio=ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value
		Thisform.OldId_Categoria_TipoAs=ThisForm.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value
		thisform.OldFechaDesde=ThisForm.TbxFecD.Value
		thisform.OldFechaHasta=ThisForm.TbxFech.Value
		thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion=thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda()
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cTexto,oLst
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","tg_compconsultaasientos",thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarsubdiario
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta(.f.)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		lParameters lMoverFocus
		Local nOpcion,dFecD,dFecH,dFecIni,dFecFin,lRetorna,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		dFecD=ThisForm.TbxFecD.Value
		dFecH=ThisForm.TbxFecH.Value
		
		dFecIni=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		dFecFin=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		
		
		If dFecd > dFecH
			dFecH=dFecd
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecH)
			dFech=dFecFin
		Endif
		If Empty(dFecD)
			dFecD=dFecIni
		Endif
		
		lRetorna=.t.
		
		If dFecd > DFecFin or dFecd < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.TbxFecD.SetFocus()
			lRetorna=.f.
		
		Endif
		If dFecH > DFecFin or dFecH < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.TbxFech.SetFocus()
			lRetorna=.f.
		
		Endif
		
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value="TD"
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=""
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		Else
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
		Endif
		
		If lRetorna
		
			nOpcion=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.value
			thisform.LockScreen=.t.	
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
			Thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Refrescar(ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Value,ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value,thisform.Tg_Presentamoneda1.ConsultarMoneda(),nOpcion,dFecD, dFecH,,,cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde,cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta)
			thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias
				
			thisform.RefrescarGrilla(lMoverFocus)		
		Endif	
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
		
		thisform.LockScreen=.F.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		lParameters lLlevaFocoAGrilla
		
		
		** Parametro intocable porque a veces no puedo hacer el setfocus cuando se hace
		** un refrescarAplicacion desde otro objeto, este no puede tomar el foco sino
		** se lo debe dejar al otro objeto sin quitarselo
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource						=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Id_Sucursal"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".ImpDebe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".ImpHaber"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Alias+".Saldo"
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.	
		
		*!*	If lLlevaFocoAGrilla
		*!*		thisform.tg_grid1.SetFocus()
		*!*		thisform.CtaValidada=.f.  && Este setfocus produce otro valid del cliente
		*!*	Endif							  && Pongo este flag para que no cargue la vista de nuevo
		
		thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.IrUltimo
		thisform.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		
		For mmpp=1 to 11-ThisForm.FilaGrillaRelativa
			thisform.tg_grid1.DoScroll(0)
		EndFor
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.ActivateCell(ThisForm.tg_grid1.RelativeRow,8)
		
		ThisForm.tg_grid1.Refresh
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDatosCuenta.Click
		Local oAbmGen
		
		oAbmGen=CreateObject("tg_FormConsulta","CTasContables",.f.,ThisForm.Tg_ctascontables1.Value)
		oAbmGen.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Click
		this.Enabled=.f.
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
		
		thisform.RefrescarConsulta
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TbxFecD.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=ThisForm.TbxFecd.Value<>thisform.OldFechaDesde
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldFechaDesde=Thisform.TbxFecd.Value	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE TbxFecH.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=ThisForm.TbxFech.Value<>thisform.OldFechaHasta
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldFechaHasta=Thisform.TbxFech.Value	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value<>thisform.OldId_Categoria_TipoAs
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		thisform.OldId_Categoria_TipoAs=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value<>thisform.OldId_Ejercicio
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldId_Ejercicio=Thisform.Tg_CmbEjerciciosCont1.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.InteractiveChange
		thisform.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(this.Value)
		Thisform.oLblNombreContable.Caption= thisform.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.KeyPress
		LPARAMETERS nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl
		
		If nKeyCode = 13 
			thisform.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(this.Value)
			Thisform.oLblNombreContable.Caption= thisform.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre")
		Endif
		
		dodefault(nKeyCode, nShiftAltCtrl)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.LostFocus
		If !this.FormDesactivado And Thisform.CtaValidada
			If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
				ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=this.Value<>thisform.OldId_CtaContable
				ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
			Endif	
			Thisform.OldId_CtaContable=this.Value
		
		Endif	
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.ProgrammaticChange
		thisform.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(this.Value)
		Thisform.oLblNombreContable.Caption= thisform.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.Valid
		local lValida
		lValida=tg_textclave::valid()
		if lValida.and.!this.FormDesactivado.and.!thisform.CtaValidada
				thisform.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(this.Value)
				Thisform.oLblNombreContable.Caption= thisform.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre")
				thisform.CtaValidada=.t.
		endif
		If (thisform.CtaValidada.or.lValida).and.!this.FormDesactivado
			thisform.oCmdDatosCuenta.Enabled=.t.
		Else
			Thisform.oLblNombreContable.Caption= Space(10)
			thisform.oCmdDatosCuenta.Enabled=.f.
		Endif	
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.AfterRowColChange
		LPARAMETERS nColIndex
		thisform.FilaGrillaRelativa=this.RelativeRow
		thisform.FilaGrillaAbsoluta=this.ActiveRow
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column1.Text1.GotFocus
		Local cColor
		thisform.Recno=thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Recno()
		cColor=this.Parent.DynamicBackColor
		this.BackColor=&cColor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column2.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column2.Text1.GotFocus
		Local cColor
		thisform.Recno=thisform.oViewCntMovimientos.Recno()
		cColor=this.Parent.DynamicBackColor
		this.BackColor=&cColor
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.Text1.DblClick
		thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.Column3.Text1.GotFocus
		Local cColor

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.interactivechange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled=This.Tg_Cmbmonedas1.Value<>thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion  .or. this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()<>thisform.OldTipoCotizacion
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutarConsulta.Enabled		
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldId_MonedaPresentacion=This.Tg_CmbMonedas1.Value
		thisform.OldTipoCotizacion=this.ConsultarTipoCotizacion()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DODEFAULT()
		
		thisForm.AddObject("oViewConsCtas", "tg_viewConsMovimientosCtaContable")
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblCtasContables", "tg_Tabla", "CtasContables","Clave")
		
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblVnt_docu", "tg_Tabla", "Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblcmp_docu", "tg_Tabla", "Cmp_Docu","Clave")
				
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType = 1
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.ReadOnly = .T.
		
		thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value = CTOD("  /  /  ")
		thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value = CTOD("  /  /  ")
		
		*** mATIAS l. 14/04/2021
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oapp.usuario) AND !EMPTY(thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie"))
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value = thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie")
		Else
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.SetearTodos()
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value="TD"
		ENDIF 
		*** mATIAS l. 14/04/2021
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		*** MATIAS L. 12/08/2020
		do case
			case  thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "V"  && Consulta ventas 
				IF thisform.oTblVnt_docu.buscar(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
					IF !thisform.oTblVnt_docu.leer("cobranza")
						If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas")<>"O"
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.Show()		
					ELSE
						If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza")<>"O"
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)
						Endif	
						thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza.Show()		   		   
					endif	
				ENDIF
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "C"  && Consulta Compras 
				IF thisform.oTblcmp_docu.buscar(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
					IF thisform.oTblcmp_docu.leer("pago")
						If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago")<>"O"
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago","Tg_ConsultaPago",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago.ConsultarPago(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)
						Endif	
						thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago.Show()
					ELSE
						If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras")<>"O"			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()	
					endif
				ENDIF
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "B"  && Consulta Banco tg_conscompbanco
				If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco")<>"O"
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco","tg_conscompbanco",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco.ConsultarCompBanco(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Endif	
				thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco.Show()
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "A"
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>"O"			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()	
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "N"
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont")<>"O"			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont","tg_compconsultaasientos",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
				Endif	
		
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont.Show()
			
		ENDCASE
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		LOCAL dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta
		** Matias L. 14/04/2021
		LOCAL cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde, cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta
		** Matias L. 14/04/2021
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType = 1
		
		IF EMPTY(thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value)
			dFechaDesde = oApp.TomarMinimaFecha()
		ELSE 
			dFechaDesde = thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value
		ENDIF 
		
		IF EMPTY(thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value)
			dFechaHasta = oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		ELSE 
			dFechaHasta = thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value
		ENDIF 
		
		*** Matias L.  14/04/2021
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value="TD"
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=""
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		Else
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
		ENDIF
		*** Matias L. 14/04/2021
		*thisForm.oViewConsCtas.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_ctascontables1.Value, dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta)
		thisForm.oViewConsCtas.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_ctascontables1.Value, dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta, cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde, cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta, ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value)
		*** Matias L.  14/04/2021
		
		thisForm.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource				=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Comprobante"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".ImpDebe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".ImpHaber"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Entidad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Sistema"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		
		** SERGIO 03/05/2023 # 1603
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		** SERGIO 03/05/2023 # 1603
		
		
		thisForm.tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		*** Chiara 21/01/21
		Dimension this.vTitulos [4,2]
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Código de Cuenta             : "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = alltrim(thisform.tg_ctascontables1.Value)
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Cuenta Contable              : "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = alltrim(thisForm.lblCuenta.Caption)
		this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Período Consultado           : "
		this.vTitulos[3,2] = alltrim(DTOC(thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value)) + " - " + alltrim(DTOC(thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value))
		this.vTitulos[4,1] = "Ejercicio                    : "
		this.vTitulos[4,2] = alltrim(ThisForm.tg_cmbejercicioscont1.DisplayValue)
		
		dodefault()
		*** Chiara 21/01/21
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		
		If Empty(Thisform.tg_ctascontables1.value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar la cuenta contable a consultar!")
			ThisForm.tg_ctascontables1.Setfocus()
			Return .t.
		ENDIF
		
		
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar el ejercicio contable a consultar!")
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Setfocus()
			Return .t.
		ENDIF
		
		
		thisForm.refrescarConsulta()
		thisForm.tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.LostFocus
		IF !EMPTY(this.Value)
			IF thisForm.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(this.Value,.F.,"Clave")
				thisForm.lblCuenta.Caption = ALLTRIM(thisForm.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre"))
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		Thisform.MostrarComprobante()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		DODEFAULT()
		
		thisForm.AddObject("oViewConsCtas", "tg_viewConsMovimientosCtaContable")
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblCtasContables", "tg_Tabla", "CtasContables","Clave")
		
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblVnt_docu", "tg_Tabla", "Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblcmp_docu", "tg_Tabla", "Cmp_Docu","Clave")
				
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType = 1
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.ReadOnly = .T.
		
		thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value = CTOD("  /  /  ")
		thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value = CTOD("  /  /  ")
		
		*** mATIAS l. 14/04/2021
		IF thisform.oTblUsuarios.buscar(oapp.usuario) AND !EMPTY(thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie"))
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value = thisform.oTblUsuarios.leer("tipcatasie")
		Else
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.SetearTodos()
			thisform.Tg_cmbCategoria_TipoAs1.Value="TD"
		ENDIF 
		*** mATIAS l. 14/04/2021
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		*** MATIAS L. 12/08/2020
		do case
			case  thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "V"  && Consulta ventas 
				IF thisform.oTblVnt_docu.buscar(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
					IF !thisform.oTblVnt_docu.leer("cobranza")
						If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas")<>"O"
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.Show()		
					ELSE
						If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza")<>"O"
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)
						Endif	
						thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza.Show()		   		   
					endif	
				ENDIF
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "C"  && Consulta Compras 
				IF thisform.oTblcmp_docu.buscar(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
					IF thisform.oTblcmp_docu.leer("pago")
						If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago")<>"O"
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago","Tg_ConsultaPago",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago.ConsultarPago(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)
						Endif	
						thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago.Show()
					ELSE
						If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras")<>"O"			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()	
					endif
				ENDIF
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "B"  && Consulta Banco tg_conscompbanco
				If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco")<>"O"
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco","tg_conscompbanco",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco.ConsultarCompBanco(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Endif	
				thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco.Show()
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "A"
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>"O"			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()	
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "N"
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont")<>"O"			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont","tg_compconsultaasientos",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
				Endif	
		
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont.Show()
			
		ENDCASE
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		LOCAL dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta
		** Matias L. 14/04/2021
		LOCAL cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde, cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta
		** Matias L. 14/04/2021
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType = 1
		
		IF EMPTY(thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value)
			dFechaDesde = oApp.TomarMinimaFecha()
		ELSE 
			dFechaDesde = thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value
		ENDIF 
		
		IF EMPTY(thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value)
			dFechaHasta = oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		ELSE 
			dFechaHasta = thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value
		ENDIF 
		
		*** Matias L.  14/04/2021
		If ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value="TD"
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=""
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=oApp.TomarMaximoString()
		Else
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
			cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta=ThisForm.Tg_cmbcategoria_tipoas1.Value
		ENDIF
		*** Matias L. 14/04/2021
		*thisForm.oViewConsCtas.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_ctascontables1.Value, dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta)
		thisForm.oViewConsCtas.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_ctascontables1.Value, dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta, cId_Categoria_TipoAsDesde, cId_Categoria_TipoAsHasta, ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value)
		*** Matias L.  14/04/2021
		
		thisForm.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource				=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Comprobante"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".ImpDebe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".ImpHaber"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Entidad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Sistema"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		
		thisForm.tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		*** Chiara 21/01/21
		Dimension this.vTitulos [4,2]
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Código de Cuenta             : "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = alltrim(thisform.tg_ctascontables1.Value)
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Cuenta Contable              : "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = alltrim(thisForm.lblCuenta.Caption)
		this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Período Consultado           : "
		this.vTitulos[3,2] = alltrim(DTOC(thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value)) + " - " + alltrim(DTOC(thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value))
		this.vTitulos[4,1] = "Ejercicio                    : "
		this.vTitulos[4,2] = alltrim(ThisForm.tg_cmbejercicioscont1.DisplayValue)
		
		dodefault()
		*** Chiara 21/01/21
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		
		If Empty(Thisform.tg_ctascontables1.value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar la cuenta contable a consultar!")
			ThisForm.tg_ctascontables1.Setfocus()
			Return .t.
		ENDIF
		
		
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar el ejercicio contable a consultar!")
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Setfocus()
			Return .t.
		ENDIF
		
		
		thisForm.refrescarConsulta()
		thisForm.tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.LostFocus
		IF !EMPTY(this.Value)
			IF thisForm.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(this.Value,.F.,"Clave")
				thisForm.lblCuenta.Caption = ALLTRIM(thisForm.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre"))
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		Thisform.MostrarComprobante()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE Init
		DODEFAULT()
		
		thisForm.AddObject("oViewConsCtas", "tg_viewConsMovimientosCtaContable")
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblCtasContables", "tg_Tabla", "CtasContables","Clave")
		
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblVnt_docu", "tg_Tabla", "Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		thisForm.AddObject("oTblcmp_docu", "tg_Tabla", "Cmp_Docu","Clave")
				
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType = 1
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.ReadOnly = .T.
		
		thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value = CTOD("  /  /  ")
		thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value = CTOD("  /  /  ")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		*** MATIAS L. 12/08/2020
		do case
			case  thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "V"  && Consulta ventas 
				IF thisform.oTblVnt_docu.buscar(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
					IF !thisform.oTblVnt_docu.leer("cobranza")
						If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas")<>"O"
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas","TG_ConsultaComprobante",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVentas.Show()		
					ELSE
						If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza")<>"O"
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza.ConsultarCobranza(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)
						Endif	
						thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecobranza.Show()		   		   
					endif	
				ENDIF
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "C"  && Consulta Compras 
				IF thisform.oTblcmp_docu.buscar(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),.f.,"Clave")
					IF thisform.oTblcmp_docu.leer("pago")
						If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago")<>"O"
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago","Tg_ConsultaPago",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago.ConsultarPago(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.leer("nro_referencia"),.t.)
						Endif	
						thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantepago.Show()
					ELSE
						If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras")<>"O"			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantecompras.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()	
					endif
				ENDIF
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "B"  && Consulta Banco tg_conscompbanco
				If Type("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco")<>"O"
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco","tg_conscompbanco",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco.ConsultarCompBanco(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Endif	
				thisform.ofrmconsultacomprobantebanco.Show()
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "A"
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>"O"			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),.t.)
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()	
				
			case thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema")= "N"
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont")<>"O"			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont","tg_compconsultaasientos",thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont.ConsultarComprobante(thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Comproba"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Nro_Referencia"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sucursal"),thisform.oViewConsCtas.Leer("Id_Sistema"),.t.)			
				Endif	
		
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCont.Show()
			
		ENDCASE
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
		LOCAL dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta
		
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSource = ""
		thisForm.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType = 1
		
		IF EMPTY(thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value)
			dFechaDesde = oApp.TomarMinimaFecha()
		ELSE 
			dFechaDesde = thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value
		ENDIF 
		
		IF EMPTY(thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value)
			dFechaHasta = oApp.TomarMaximaFecha()
		ELSE 
			dFechaHasta = thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value
		ENDIF 
		
		
		dFecIni=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		dFecFin=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value)
		
		
		If dFechaDesde > dFechaHasta
			dFechaHasta=dFechaDesde
		ENDIF
		
		If Empty(dFechaHasta)
			dFechaHasta=dFecFin
		ENDIF
		
		If Empty(dFechaDesde)
			dFechaDesde=dFecIni
		Endif
		
		lRetorna=.t.
		
		If dFechaDesde > DFecFin or dFechaDesde < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			thisForm.txtFechaDesde.SetFocus()
			lRetorna=.f.
		
		Endif
		If dFechaHasta > DFecFin or dFechaHasta < dFecIni
			=fMensAceptar("Fecha fuera del Ejercicio Contable. Periodo: " + Dtoc(DFecIni) +;
										"-" + Dtoc(DFecFin) )
			ThisForm.txtFechaHasta.SetFocus()
			lRetorna=.f.
		Endif
		
		thisForm.oViewConsCtas.Refrescar(thisForm.tg_ctascontables1.Value, dFechaDesde, dFechaHasta, ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value)
		
		thisForm.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.RecordSource				=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Fecha"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Detalle"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Comprobante"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".ImpDebe"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".ImpHaber"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Saldo"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Entidad"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Sistema"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource		=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Id_Comproba"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column10.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Nro_Referencia"
		thisform.tg_grid1.Column11.ControlSource	=	thisform.oViewConsCtas.Alias+".Nro_Externo"
		
		thisForm.tg_Grid1.Refresh()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		*** Chiara 21/01/21
		Dimension this.vTitulos [4,2]
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Código de Cuenta             : "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = alltrim(thisform.tg_ctascontables1.Value)
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Cuenta Contable              : "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = alltrim(thisForm.lblCuenta.Caption)
		this.vTitulos[3,1] = "Período Consultado           : "
		this.vTitulos[3,2] = alltrim(DTOC(thisForm.txtFechaDesde.Value)) + " - " + alltrim(DTOC(thisForm.txtFechaHasta.Value))
		this.vTitulos[4,1] = "Ejercicio                    : "
		this.vTitulos[4,2] = alltrim(ThisForm.tg_cmbejercicioscont1.DisplayValue)
		
		dodefault()
		*** Chiara 21/01/21
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_commandbutton1.Click
		
		If Empty(Thisform.tg_ctascontables1.value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar la cuenta contable a consultar!")
			ThisForm.tg_ctascontables1.Setfocus()
			Return .t.
		ENDIF
		
		
		If Empty(ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.value)
			=fMensAceptar("Debe indicar el ejercicio contable a consultar!")
			ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Setfocus()
			Return .t.
		ENDIF
		
		thisForm.refrescarConsulta()
		thisForm.tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled = .T.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_ctascontables1.LostFocus
		IF !EMPTY(this.Value)
			IF thisForm.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(this.Value,.F.,"Clave")
				thisForm.lblCuenta.Caption = ALLTRIM(thisForm.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre"))
			ENDIF 
		ENDIF 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		Thisform.MostrarComprobante()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE darfechafinal
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darfechainicio
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutar
		Local cId_Ejercicio,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		If  Thisform.Validar()
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
			dFechaDesde=ThisForm.oTbxFechaD.Value
			dFechaHasta=ThisForm.oTbxFechaH.Value
			cId_Ejercicio=ThisForm.oCmbEjerciciosCont.Value
			cId_MonedaPresentacion=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
			nTipoCotizacion=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
			
			If !Empty(dFechaDesde) And Empty(dFechaHasta)
				dFechaHasta=dFechaDesde
			Endif
			If dFechaDesde > dFechaHasta
				dFechaHasta=dFechaDesde
			Endif
			If Empty(dFechaDesde)
				dFechaDesde=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)
			Endif
			If Empty(dFechaHasta)
				dFechaHasta=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(cID_Ejercicio)
			Endif
		
		
		
			Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Refrescar(cId_Ejercicio,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion)
			Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","TG_Tabla","Parametros")
		
		******* Vista
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewOrigenAplicaciones","Tg_ViewCntOrigenAplicaciones")
		
		Thisform.OldoTbxFechaD=Ctod(Space(6))
		ThisForm.OldoTbxFechaH=Ctod(Space(6))
		ThisForm.OldoCmbEjerciciosCont=Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Id_Ejercicio")
		Thisform.OldMoneda=Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def")
		Thisform.OldCotiza=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value=ThisForm.OldMoneda
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaD.Value=Thisform.OldoTbxFechaD
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaH.Value=Thisform.OldoTbxFechaH
		ThisForm.oCmbEjerciciosCont.Value=Thisform.OldoCmbEjerciciosCont
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		Thisform.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmayor
		LParameters cCuenta
		Local cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH
		cId_CtaContable =Left(cCuenta,20)
		cId_Ejercicio   =ThisForm.oCmbEjerciciosCont.Value
		cId_Moneda      =ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		nTipoCotizacion =ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		dFechaD					=ThisForm.oTbxFechaD.Value
		dFechaH					=ThisForm.oTbxFechaH.Value
		
		If Empty(dFechaD)
			dFechaD=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)
		Endif
		If Empty(dFechaH)
			dFechaH=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)	
		Endif	
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor")<>"0" 
		 	thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor","TG_ConsMayorContabilidad",cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH)
		Else
			thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor.Init(cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH)			
		Endif	
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias + ".Id_CtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias + ".Nombre"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias + ".nInicial"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias + ".nFinal"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias + ".nDiferencia"
		
		** SERGIO 03/05/2023 # 1603
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column3.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column4.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column5.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		** SERGIO 03/05/2023 # 1603
		
		Thisform.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar
		Local cMensaje,cID_Ejercicio
		Local dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta
		
		cId_Ejercicio=ThisForm.oCmbEjerciciosCont.Value
		
		If !ThisForm.VerificarFecha(ThisForm.oTbxFechaD.Value,cId_Ejercicio,@cMensaje)
			ThisForm.oTbxFechaD.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		If !ThisForm.VerificarFecha(ThisForm.oTbxFechaH.Value,cId_Ejercicio,@cMensaje)
			ThisForm.oTbxFechaH.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		
		
		Return .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE verificarfecha
		LParameters dFecha,cId_Ejercicio,cMensaje
		
		If Empty(dFecha)
			Return .t.
		Endif
		If dFecha < oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)
			cMensaje="Debe indicar una fecha mayor o igual a la fecha de inicio del Ejercicio Contable. Fecha de Inicio:" + Dtoc(oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio))
		Endif
		If dFecha > oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)
			cMensaje="Debe indicar una fecha menor o igual a la fecha de inicio del Ejercicio Contable. Fecha de Inicio:" + Dtoc(oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio))
		Endif
		
		If !Empty(cMensaje)
			=fMensAceptar(cMensaje)
			Return .f.
		Endif
		
		Return .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmbEjerciciosCont.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>ThisForm.OldoCmbEjerciciosCont
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled			
		Endif	
		ThisForm.OldoCmbEjerciciosCont=This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutar.Click
		Thisform.Ejecutar()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaD.LostFocus
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>thisform.OldoTbxFechaD
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled		
			
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldoTbxFechaD=This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaH.LostFocus
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>thisform.OldoTbxFechaH
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled			
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldoTbxFechaH=This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		ThisForm.MostrarMayor(Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Leer("Id_CtaContable") )
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>ThisForm.OldCotiza
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled			
		Endif	
		ThisForm.OldCotiza=This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>ThisForm.OldMoneda
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled			
		Endif	
		ThisForm.OldMoneda=This.Value
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE darfechafinal
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE darfechainicio
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE ejecutar
		Local cId_Ejercicio,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion
		
		thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		
		If  Thisform.Validar()
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
			ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
			dFechaDesde=ThisForm.oTbxFechaD.Value
			dFechaHasta=ThisForm.oTbxFechaH.Value
			cId_Ejercicio=ThisForm.oCmbEjerciciosCont.Value
			cId_MonedaPresentacion=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
			nTipoCotizacion=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
			
			If !Empty(dFechaDesde) And Empty(dFechaHasta)
				dFechaHasta=dFechaDesde
			Endif
			If dFechaDesde > dFechaHasta
				dFechaHasta=dFechaDesde
			Endif
			If Empty(dFechaDesde)
				dFechaDesde=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)
			Endif
			If Empty(dFechaHasta)
				dFechaHasta=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(cID_Ejercicio)
			Endif
		
		
		
			Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Refrescar(cId_Ejercicio,dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion)
			Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=.f.
		Endif
		
		thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
			
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblParametros","TG_Tabla","Parametros")
		
		******* Vista
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewOrigenAplicaciones","Tg_ViewCntOrigenAplicaciones")
		
		Thisform.OldoTbxFechaD=Ctod(Space(6))
		ThisForm.OldoTbxFechaH=Ctod(Space(6))
		ThisForm.OldoCmbEjerciciosCont=Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Id_Ejercicio")
		Thisform.OldMoneda=Thisform.oTblParametros.Leer("Mon_Def")
		Thisform.OldCotiza=ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		
		ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value=ThisForm.OldMoneda
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaD.Value=Thisform.OldoTbxFechaD
		ThisForm.oTbxFechaH.Value=Thisform.OldoTbxFechaH
		ThisForm.oCmbEjerciciosCont.Value=Thisform.OldoCmbEjerciciosCont
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		Thisform.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarmayor
		LParameters cCuenta
		Local cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH
		cId_CtaContable =Left(cCuenta,20)
		cId_Ejercicio   =ThisForm.oCmbEjerciciosCont.Value
		cId_Moneda      =ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.Value
		nTipoCotizacion =ThisForm.Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.Value
		dFechaD					=ThisForm.oTbxFechaD.Value
		dFechaH					=ThisForm.oTbxFechaH.Value
		
		If Empty(dFechaD)
			dFechaD=oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)
		Endif
		If Empty(dFechaH)
			dFechaH=oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)	
		Endif	
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor")<>"0" 
		 	thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor","TG_ConsMayorContabilidad",cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH)
		Else
			thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor.Init(cId_CtaContable,cId_Ejercicio,cId_Moneda,nTipoCotizacion,dFechaD,dFechaH)			
		Endif	
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaMayor.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.LockScreen=.t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias + ".Id_CtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias + ".Nombre"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias + ".nInicial"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias + ".nFinal"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Alias + ".nDiferencia"
		
		Thisform.Tg_Grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE validar
		Local cMensaje,cID_Ejercicio
		Local dFechaDesde,dFechaHasta
		
		cId_Ejercicio=ThisForm.oCmbEjerciciosCont.Value
		
		If !ThisForm.VerificarFecha(ThisForm.oTbxFechaD.Value,cId_Ejercicio,@cMensaje)
			ThisForm.oTbxFechaD.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		If !ThisForm.VerificarFecha(ThisForm.oTbxFechaH.Value,cId_Ejercicio,@cMensaje)
			ThisForm.oTbxFechaH.SetFocus()
			Return .f.
		Endif
		
		
		Return .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE verificarfecha
		LParameters dFecha,cId_Ejercicio,cMensaje
		
		If Empty(dFecha)
			Return .t.
		Endif
		If dFecha < oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)
			cMensaje="Debe indicar una fecha mayor o igual a la fecha de inicio del Ejercicio Contable. Fecha de Inicio:" + Dtoc(oApp.DarFechaInicialEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio))
		Endif
		If dFecha > oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio)
			cMensaje="Debe indicar una fecha menor o igual a la fecha de inicio del Ejercicio Contable. Fecha de Inicio:" + Dtoc(oApp.DarFechaFinalEjercicio(cId_Ejercicio))
		Endif
		
		If !Empty(cMensaje)
			=fMensAceptar(cMensaje)
			Return .f.
		Endif
		
		Return .t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmbEjerciciosCont.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>ThisForm.OldoCmbEjerciciosCont
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled			
		Endif	
		ThisForm.OldoCmbEjerciciosCont=This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdEjecutar.Click
		Thisform.Ejecutar()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaD.LostFocus
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>thisform.OldoTbxFechaD
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled		
			
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldoTbxFechaD=This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oTbxFechaH.LostFocus
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>thisform.OldoTbxFechaH
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled			
		Endif	
		Thisform.OldoTbxFechaH=This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		ThisForm.MostrarMayor(Thisform.oViewOrigenAplicaciones.Leer("Id_CtaContable") )
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.oOpgTipoCotizacion.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>ThisForm.OldCotiza
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled			
		Endif	
		ThisForm.OldCotiza=This.Value
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_presentamoneda1.Tg_cmbmonedas1.InteractiveChange
		If Not ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled
			ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled=This.Value<>ThisForm.OldMoneda
			ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oCmdEjecutar.Enabled			
		Endif	
		ThisForm.OldMoneda=This.Value
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE consultar
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_ctaContable,lOcultar
		
		ThisForm.Id_Sucursal		= cId_Sucursal
		ThisForm.Id_Sistema 		= cId_Sistema
		ThisForm.Id_Comproba	  = cId_Comproba
		ThisForm.Nro_Referencia = nNro_Referencia
		ThisForm.Id_ctaContable= cId_CtaContable
		
		ThisForm.Ocultar=lOcultar
		
		thisform.SetearCaption("Comprobantes de Gestion de la Cuenta Contable " + cId_CtaContable)
		
		ThisForm.RefrescarGrilla()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE escobranza
		LParameters cID_Comproba
		ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE espago
		LParameters cId_Comproba
		ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("Pago")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_CtaContable,lOcultar
		DoDefault()
		
		ThisForm.Id_Sucursal		= cId_Sucursal
		ThisForm.Id_Sistema 		= cId_Sistema
		ThisForm.Id_Comproba	  = cId_Comproba
		ThisForm.Nro_Referencia = nNro_Referencia
		ThisForm.Id_CtaContable = cId_CtaContable
		
		*** Matias L. 20/04/2021
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblvnt_cabecera","Tg_Tabla","vnt_cabecera","Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblcmp_cabecera","Tg_Tabla","cmp_cabecera","Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblcaj_cabecera","Tg_Tabla","caj_cabecera","Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblban_cabecera","Tg_Tabla","ban_cabecera","Clave")
		*** Matias L. 20/04/2021
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oViewCntCmpDelAsiento","Tg_ViewCntCmpdelAsiento")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblCmp_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Cmp_Docu","Clave")
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid1.ResaltarRenglon(6,7)
		thisform.SetearCaption("Comprobantes de Gestion de la Cuenta Contable " + cId_CtaContable)
		
		ThisForm.Ocultar=lOcultar
		
		ThisForm.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar,cId_sistemaLlamador
		
		cId_comproba    =	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		nNro_Referencia	=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		cId_sucursal		=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		cId_sistema			=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		cId_sistemaLlamador=oApp.CodSistema("Contabilidad")
		lOcultar=.T.
		
		Do Case
		
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")
				IF thisform.oTblvnt_cabecera.buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"CLAVE")
					If ThisForm.EsCobranza(cId_Comproba)
			 			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
					Else	  
				  		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
					ENDIF
				ELSE 
					=fMensAceptar("El comprobante fue depurado.")	
				ENDIF
			Case CId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Compras")
				IF thisform.oTblcmp_cabecera.buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+STR(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"CLAVE")
					If ThisForm.EsPago(cId_Comproba)	
						If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
					Else	
						If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
					ENDIF
				ELSE 
					=fMensAceptar("El comprobante fue depurado.")	
				ENDIF
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Banco")
				IF thisform.oTblban_cabecera.buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"CLAVE")
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos","TG_ConsCompBanco",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.ConsultarCompBanco(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.Show()
				ELSE 
					=fMensAceptar("El comprobante fue depurado.")	
				ENDIF		
			Case cId_sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Caja")
				IF thisform.oTblcaj_cabecera.buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"CLAVE")
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()
				ELSE 
					=fMensAceptar("El comprobante fue depurado.")	
				ENDIF
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Cobradores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores","TG_ConsCompCobradores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.ConsultarCompCobradores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.Show()
				
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores","TG_ConsCompVendedores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.ConsultarCompVendedores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.Show()
			
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Stock")	
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock","TG_ConsCompStock",cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.ConsultarCompStock(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.Show()	
				
		EndCase
		
		
		
		*!*	Local cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar,cId_sistemaLlamador
		
		*!*	cId_comproba    =	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		*!*	nNro_Referencia	=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		*!*	cId_sucursal		=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		*!*	cId_sistema			=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		*!*	cId_sistemaLlamador=oApp.CodSistema("Contabilidad")
		*!*	lOcultar=.T.
		*!*	Do Case
		*!*		Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")
		*!*		  If ThisForm.EsCobranza(cId_Comproba)
		*!*		 		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*				Else
		*!*					Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*				Endif	
		*!*				thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
		*!*			Else	  
		*!*		  	If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
		*!*				Else
		*!*					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
		*!*				Endif	
		*!*				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		*!*			Endif
		*!*		Case CId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Compras")
		*!*			If ThisForm.EsPago(cId_Comproba)	
		*!*				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*				Else
		*!*					Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*				Endif	
		*!*				thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
		*!*			Else	
		*!*				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
		*!*				Else
		*!*					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
		*!*				Endif	
		*!*				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*		Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Banco")
		*!*			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos","TG_ConsCompBanco",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*			Else
		*!*				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.ConsultarCompBanco(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.Show()
		*!*			
		*!*		Case cId_sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Caja")
		*!*			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*			Else
		*!*				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()
		
		*!*		Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Cobradores")
		*!*			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores","TG_ConsCompCobradores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*			Else
		*!*				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.ConsultarCompCobradores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.Show()
		*!*			
		*!*		Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
		*!*			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores","TG_ConsCompVendedores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*			Else
		*!*				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.ConsultarCompVendedores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.Show()
		*!*		
		*!*		Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Stock")	
		*!*			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock","TG_ConsCompStock",cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*			Else
		*!*				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.ConsultarCompStock(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.Show()	
		*!*			
		*!*	EndCase
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		ThisForm.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Refrescar(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.Id_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia,ThisForm.Id_CtaContable)
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias 
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".Id_Sucursal" 
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".NomSistema"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".NomComproba"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".Nro_Referencia"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".NomMoneda"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".ImpDebe"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".ImpHaber"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".ImpSaldo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".Fecha"
		
		** SERGIO 03/05/2023 # 1603
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column6.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column7.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		Thisform.tg_grid1.Column8.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		** SERGIO 03/05/2023 # 1603
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid1.Refresh
		ThisForm.Refresh
		
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.EsTablaVacia()
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE salir
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.Ocultar
			ThisForm.Release
		Else
			ThisForm.Hide
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		ThisForm.Salir
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		ThisForm.MostrarComprobante()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
