	PROCEDURE consultar
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_ctaContable,lOcultar
		
		ThisForm.Id_Sucursal		= cId_Sucursal
		ThisForm.Id_Sistema 		= cId_Sistema
		ThisForm.Id_Comproba	  = cId_Comproba
		ThisForm.Nro_Referencia = nNro_Referencia
		ThisForm.Id_ctaContable= cId_CtaContable
		
		ThisForm.Ocultar=lOcultar
		
		thisform.SetearCaption("Comprobantes de Gestion de la Cuenta Contable " + cId_CtaContable)
		
		ThisForm.RefrescarGrilla()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE escobranza
		LParameters cID_Comproba
		ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE espago
		LParameters cId_Comproba
		ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("Pago")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_CtaContable,lOcultar
		DoDefault()
		
		ThisForm.Id_Sucursal		= cId_Sucursal
		ThisForm.Id_Sistema 		= cId_Sistema
		ThisForm.Id_Comproba	  = cId_Comproba
		ThisForm.Nro_Referencia = nNro_Referencia
		ThisForm.Id_CtaContable = cId_CtaContable
		
		*** Matias L. 20/04/2021
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblvnt_cabecera","Tg_Tabla","vnt_cabecera","Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblcmp_cabecera","Tg_Tabla","cmp_cabecera","Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblcaj_cabecera","Tg_Tabla","caj_cabecera","Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblban_cabecera","Tg_Tabla","ban_cabecera","Clave")
		*** Matias L. 20/04/2021
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oViewCntCmpDelAsiento","Tg_ViewCntCmpdelAsiento")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblCmp_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Cmp_Docu","Clave")
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid1.ResaltarRenglon(6,7)
		thisform.SetearCaption("Comprobantes de Gestion de la Cuenta Contable " + cId_CtaContable)
		
		ThisForm.Ocultar=lOcultar
		
		ThisForm.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar,cId_sistemaLlamador
		
		cId_comproba    =	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		nNro_Referencia	=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		cId_sucursal		=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		cId_sistema			=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		cId_sistemaLlamador=oApp.CodSistema("Contabilidad")
		lOcultar=.T.
		
		Do Case
		
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")
				IF thisform.oTblvnt_cabecera.buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"CLAVE")
					If ThisForm.EsCobranza(cId_Comproba)
			 			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
					Else	  
				  		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
					ENDIF
				ELSE 
					=fMensAceptar("El comprobante fue depurado.")	
				ENDIF
			Case CId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Compras")
				IF thisform.oTblcmp_cabecera.buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+STR(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"CLAVE")
					If ThisForm.EsPago(cId_Comproba)	
						If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
					Else	
						If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
							thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
						Else
							Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
						Endif	
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
					ENDIF
				ELSE 
					=fMensAceptar("El comprobante fue depurado.")	
				ENDIF
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Banco")
				IF thisform.oTblban_cabecera.buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"CLAVE")
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos","TG_ConsCompBanco",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.ConsultarCompBanco(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.Show()
				ELSE 
					=fMensAceptar("El comprobante fue depurado.")	
				ENDIF		
			Case cId_sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Caja")
				IF thisform.oTblcaj_cabecera.buscar(cId_sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"CLAVE")
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()
				ELSE 
					=fMensAceptar("El comprobante fue depurado.")	
				ENDIF
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Cobradores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores","TG_ConsCompCobradores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.ConsultarCompCobradores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.Show()
				
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores","TG_ConsCompVendedores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.ConsultarCompVendedores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.Show()
			
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Stock")	
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock","TG_ConsCompStock",cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.ConsultarCompStock(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.Show()	
				
		EndCase
		
		
		
		*!*	Local cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar,cId_sistemaLlamador
		
		*!*	cId_comproba    =	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		*!*	nNro_Referencia	=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		*!*	cId_sucursal		=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		*!*	cId_sistema			=	ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		*!*	cId_sistemaLlamador=oApp.CodSistema("Contabilidad")
		*!*	lOcultar=.T.
		*!*	Do Case
		*!*		Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")
		*!*		  If ThisForm.EsCobranza(cId_Comproba)
		*!*		 		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*				Else
		*!*					Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*				Endif	
		*!*				thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
		*!*			Else	  
		*!*		  	If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
		*!*				Else
		*!*					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
		*!*				Endif	
		*!*				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
		*!*			Endif
		*!*		Case CId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Compras")
		*!*			If ThisForm.EsPago(cId_Comproba)	
		*!*				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*				Else
		*!*					Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*				Endif	
		*!*				thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
		*!*			Else	
		*!*				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
		*!*				Else
		*!*					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
		*!*				Endif	
		*!*				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*		Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Banco")
		*!*			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos","TG_ConsCompBanco",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*			Else
		*!*				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.ConsultarCompBanco(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.Show()
		*!*			
		*!*		Case cId_sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Caja")
		*!*			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*			Else
		*!*				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()
		
		*!*		Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Cobradores")
		*!*			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores","TG_ConsCompCobradores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*			Else
		*!*				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.ConsultarCompCobradores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.Show()
		*!*			
		*!*		Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
		*!*			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores","TG_ConsCompVendedores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*			Else
		*!*				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.ConsultarCompVendedores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.Show()
		*!*		
		*!*		Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Stock")	
		*!*			If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock")<>T_OBJECT			 
		*!*				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock","TG_ConsCompStock",cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		*!*			Else
		*!*				Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.ConsultarCompStock(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		*!*			Endif	
		*!*			thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.Show()	
		*!*			
		*!*	EndCase
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		ThisForm.RefrescarGrilla()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Refrescar(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.Id_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia,ThisForm.Id_CtaContable)
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias 
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".Id_Sucursal" 
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".NomSistema"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".NomComproba"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".Nro_Referencia"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".NomMoneda"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".ImpDebe"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".ImpHaber"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".ImpSaldo"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column9.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.Alias + ".Fecha"
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid1.Refresh
		ThisForm.Refresh
		
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=!ThisForm.oViewCntCmpDelAsiento.EsTablaVacia()
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen=.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE salir
		dodefault()
		If !ThisForm.Ocultar
			ThisForm.Release
		Else
			ThisForm.Hide
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		ThisForm.Salir
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		ThisForm.MostrarComprobante()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE consultar
		lParameters cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion,lOcultar
		
		
		Thisform.Ocultar=lOcultar
		
		Thisform.oTblCnt_Docu.Buscar(cId_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		ThisForm.oTbxNombreAsiento.Value = Thisform.oTblCnt_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
		ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value = nNro_Referencia
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordsourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion)
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		ThisForm.Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Enabled=.t.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE escobranza
		LParameters cID_Comproba
		ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE espago
		LParameters cId_Comproba
		ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("Pago")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion,lOcultar
		
		
		dodefault()
		
		ThisForm.AddObject("oViewSubdiarioContable","tg_viewsubdiariocontable")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Cmp_Docu","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCnt_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Cnt_Docu","Clave")
		
		
		Thisform.Consultar(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_MonedaPresentacion,nTipoCotizacion,lOcultar)
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar,cId_sistemaLlamador
		
		cId_comproba    =	Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		nNro_Referencia	=	Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		cId_sucursal		=	Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		cId_sistema			=	Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		cId_sistemaLlamador=oApp.CodSistema("Contabilidad")
		lOcultar=.T.
		Do Case
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")
			  If ThisForm.EsCobranza(cId_Comproba)
			 		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
				Else	  
			  	If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
				Endif
			Case CId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Compras")
				If ThisForm.EsPago(cId_Comproba)	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
				Else	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
				Endif	
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Banco")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos","TG_ConsCompBanco",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.ConsultarCompBanco(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.Show()
				
			Case cId_sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Caja")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()
		
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Cobradores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores","TG_ConsCompCobradores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.ConsultarCompCobradores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.Show()
				
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores","TG_ConsCompVendedores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.ConsultarCompVendedores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.Show()
				
		EndCase
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescarconsulta
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.LockScreen =.t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Alias 
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Alias + ".Id_Sucursal"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Alias + ".Id_Sistema"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Alias + ".Id_Comproba"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Alias + ".Nro_Referencia"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Alias + ".Fecha"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource=Thisform.oViewSubdiarioContable.Alias + ".Importe"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen = .f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btncancelar1.Click
		If Thisform.Ocultar
			Thisform.Hide
		Else
			Thisform.Release
		Endif
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnimprimirgrilla1.Click
		Dimension this.vTitulos [2,2]
		
		this.vTitulos[1,1] = "Asiento : "
		this.vTitulos[1,2] = Alltrim(ThisForm.oTbxNombreAsiento.Value ) 
		
		this.vTitulos[2,1] = "Numero : "
		this.vTitulos[2,2] = Str(ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value,10)
		
		DoDefault()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		ThisForm.MostrarComprobante()
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE consultarcabecera
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia
		Local lAbierto
		
		ThisForm.Id_Sucursal=cId_Sucursal
		ThisForm.Id_Sistema=cId_Sistema
		ThisForm.Id_Comproba=cId_Comproba
		ThisForm.Nro_Referencia=nNro_Referencia
		
		ThisForm.oTblSub_Cabecera.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"Clave")
		ThisForm.oEdtObservaciones.Value	= Thisform.oTblSub_Cabecera.Leer("Observaciones")
		ThisForm.oCmbMonedas.Value		 		=	ThisForm.oTblSub_Cabecera.Leer("Id_Moneda")
		ThisForm.oTbxSaldo.Value			 		=	ThisForm.oTblSub_Cabecera.Leer("Saldo")	
		ThisForm.oTbxNro_Referencia.Value	=	ThisForm.oTblSub_Cabecera.Leer("CntNro_Referencia")
		ThisForm.oCmbComproba.Value				=	ThisForm.oTblSub_Cabecera.Leer("CntId_Comproba")
		ThisForm.Tg_cmbejercicioscont1.Value = ThisForm.oTblSub_Cabecera.Leer("CntId_Ejercicio")
		
		Thisform.oTblCnt_Cabecera.Buscar(ThisForm.oTblSub_Cabecera.Leer("CntId_Sucursal")+ThisForm.oTblSub_Cabecera.Leer("CntId_Sistema")+ThisForm.oTblSub_Cabecera.Leer("CntId_Comproba")+Str(ThisForm.oTblSub_Cabecera.Leer("CntNro_Referencia"),10),.f.,"Clave")
		ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value=ThisForm.oTblCnt_Cabecera.Leer("Nro_Externo")
		
		lAbierto=oApp.ConsultarAperturaAsiento(oApp.CodSucursal(),oApp.CodSistema("Contabilidad"),ThisForm.oCmbComproba.Value,ThisForm.oTbxNro_Referencia.Value)
		ThisForm.oChkAbierto.Value=lAbierto
		ThisForm.oCmdRegenerar.Enabled=lAbierto
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE controlarcentrocostos
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia
		
		Return Thisform.oTblCnt_CtrosDetalle.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"Clave" )
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE definircentroscostos
		LParameters vCentrosCostos
		
		Local lContinua,lMostrarPantalla,vAux
		
		
		lContinua = .t.
			
		Do Case
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="V"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosVentas.DefinirCentroCostos(@vCentrosCostos,@lMostrarPantalla)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="C"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosCompras.DefinirCentroCostos(@vCentrosCostos,@lMostrarPantalla)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="E"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosVendedores.DefinirCentroCostos(@vCentrosCostos,@lMostrarPantalla)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="O"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosCobradores.DefinirCentroCostos(@vCentrosCostos,@lMostrarPantalla)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="B"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosBancos.DefinirCentroCostos(@vCentrosCostos,@lMostrarPantalla)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="A"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosCaja.DefinirCentroCostos(@vCentrosCostos,@lMostrarPantalla)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="S"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosStock.DefinirCentroCostos(@vCentrosCostos,@lMostrarPantalla)
		EndCase
		
				
		If lMostrarPantalla
			If type ("thisform.oFrmCentroCostos")<>T_OBJECT
				thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmCentroCostos","Tg_FormCentroCostos")
			Endif
			thisform.oFrmCentroCostos.SetearConsulta(@vCentrosCostos)
			thisform.oFrmCentroCostos.Show			
			thisform.oFrmCentroCostos.DarVector(@vAux)
			
			dimension vCentrosCostos[Alen(vAux,1),9]
			=Acopy(vAux,vCentrosCostos)
		Endif
			
		If Type("vCentrosCostos") = "L"
			lContinua = .f.
		Endif
				
		
		Return lContinua 
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE grabarcentroscostos
		LParameters vCentroCostos
		
		
		Do Case
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="V"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosVentas.GrabarCentroCostos(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia,@vCentroCostos)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="C"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosCompras.GrabarCentroCostos(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia,@vCentroCostos)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="E"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosVendedores.GrabarCentroCostos(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia,@vCentroCostos)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="O"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosCobradores.GrabarCentroCostos(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia,@vCentroCostos)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="B"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosBancos.GrabarCentroCostos(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia,@vCentroCostos)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="A"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosCaja.GrabarCentroCostos(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia,@vCentroCostos)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="S"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosStock.GrabarCentroCostos(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia,@vCentroCostos)
		EndCase
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar
		DoDefault()
		ThisForm.AddObject("oViewCntSub_Detalle","Tg_ViewCntSub_Detalle")
		ThisForm.AddObject("oTblSub_Cabecera","Tg_Tabla","Sub_Cabecera","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCnt_Cabecera","Tg_Tabla","Cnt_Cabecera","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCnt_CtrosDetalle","Tg_Tabla","Cnt_CtrosDetalle","Clave")
		*!*	ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosBancos","Tg_SubAsientosBancos")
		*!*	ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosCaja","Tg_SubAsientosCaja")
		*!*	ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosCobradores","Tg_SubAsientosCobradores")
		*!*	ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosVendedores","Tg_SubAsientosVendedores")
		*!*	ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosCompras","Tg_SubAsientosCompras")
		*!*	ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosVentas","Tg_SubAsientosVentas")
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		thisform.Ocultar=lOcultar
		
		
		ThisForm.ConsultarCabecera(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		ThisForm.oViewCntSub_Detalle.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid1.ResaltarRenglon(3,4)
		ThisForm.RefrescarGrilla()     
		ThisForm.oCmdCentroCostos.Enabled =Thisform.controlarcentrocostos(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcentrocostos
		
		If Type("Thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos")<>"0" 
		 	thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("Thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos","TG_ConsCmpCentroCostos",ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia)
		Else
			thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos.Consultar(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia)			
		Endif	
		Thisform.oFrmConsultaCentroCostos.Show()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If !thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		*!*	ThisForm.SetearConsulta(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.Id_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		ThisForm.LockScreen= .t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		ThisForm.oViewCntSub_Detalle.IrPrimero()
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=ThisForm.oViewCntSub_Detalle.Alias
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntSub_Detalle.Alias	+ ".Id_CtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntSub_Detalle.Alias	+	".NomCta"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntSub_Detalle.Alias	+	".Debe"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntSub_Detalle.Alias	+	".Haber"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntSub_Detalle.Alias  + ".Id_Posicion"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource=ThisForm.oViewCntSub_Detalle.Alias	+ ".NomPos"
		
		
		ThisForm.Tg_Grid1.Refresh
		ThisForm.Refresh
		
		ThisForm.LockScreen =.f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE regenerarsubasiento
		Local vCentroCostos
		
		Thisform.SetearCursorEspera
		If Type("thisform.oCstSubAsientosBancos")<>T_OBJECT
		
			ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosBancos","Tg_SubAsientosBancos")
			ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosCaja","Tg_SubAsientosCaja")
			ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosCobradores","Tg_SubAsientosCobradores")
			ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosVendedores","Tg_SubAsientosVendedores")
			ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosCompras","Tg_SubAsientosCompras")
			ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosVentas","Tg_SubAsientosVentas")
			ThisForm.AddObject("oCstSubAsientosStock","Tg_SubAsientosStock")
		
		Endif	
		
		
		Do Case
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="V"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosVentas.RegenerarSubAsiento(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="C"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosCompras.RegenerarSubAsiento(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="E"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosVendedores.RegenerarSubAsiento(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="O"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosCobradores.RegenerarSubAsiento(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="B"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosBancos.RegenerarSubAsiento(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="A"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosCaja.RegenerarSubAsiento(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia)
			Case ThisForm.Id_Sistema="S"
				ThisForm.oCstSubAsientosStock.RegenerarSubAsiento(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.ID_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia)
		EndCase
		
		
		*** Martin 24/09/01
		If Thisform.DefinirCentrosCostos(@vCentroCostos)
			oApp.ComenzarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)
			thisform.GrabarCentrosCostos(@vCentroCostos)
			oApp.FinalizarTransaccion(thisform.DataSessionId)	
		Endif	
		*** Martin 24/09/01
		
		ThisForm.SetearConsulta(ThisForm.Id_Sucursal,ThisForm.Id_Sistema,ThisForm.Id_Comproba,ThisForm.Nro_Referencia)
		Thisform.DesSetearCursorEspera
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		
		ThisForm.ConsultarCabecera(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		ThisForm.oViewCntSub_Detalle.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		ThisForm.oCmdCentroCostos.Enabled =Thisform.controlarcentrocostos(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		ThisForm.Ocultar=lOcultar
		ThisForm.RefrescarGrilla()  
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCentroCostos.Click
		Thisform.MostrarCentroCostos()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		If thisform.Ocultar
			thisform.release
		Else
			thisform.Hide
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdRegenerar.Click
		ThisForm.RegenerarSubAsiento
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

		Name = "Text1"
		*< END OBJECT: BaseClass="textbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_grid1.Column7.Header1' AS header WITH ;
		Alignment = 2, ;
		Caption = "Haber", ;
		Name = "Header1"
		*< END OBJECT: BaseClass="header" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_grid1.Column7.Text1' AS textbox WITH ;
		BackColor = 255,255,255, ;
		BorderStyle = 0, ;
		ForeColor = 0,0,0, ;

		*< END OBJECT: BaseClass="textbox" />

		Alignment = 2, ;
		Caption = "Saldo", ;
		Name = "Header1"
		*< END OBJECT: BaseClass="header" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_grid1.Column8.Text1' AS textbox WITH ;
		BackColor = 255,255,255, ;
		BorderStyle = 0, ;
		ForeColor = 0,0,0, ;
		Margin = 0, ;
		Name = "Text1"
		*< END OBJECT: BaseClass="textbox" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_label1' AS tg_label WITH ;
		Caption = "Centro de Costo:", ;
		Height = 18, ;
		Left = 19, ;
		Name = "Tg_label1", ;
		Top = 7, ;
		Width = 83
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />

	ADD OBJECT 'Tg_label3' AS tg_label WITH ;
		Caption = "Cta Contable:", ;
		Height = 18, ;
		Left = 19, ;
		Name = "Tg_label3", ;
		Top = 28, ;
		Width = 78
		*< END OBJECT: ClassLib="tg_clasesbasicas.vcx" BaseClass="label" />
	
	PROCEDURE consultar
		lParameters cId_CCosto,cId_CtaContable,dFecd,dFecH,cId_Moneda,lOpcion,lOcultar
		
		Thisform.ocultar=lOcultar
		
		Thisform.Id_CCosto = cId_CCosto
		Thisform.Id_CtaContable = cId_CtaContable
		Thisform.FechaDesde= dFecd
		Thisform.FechaHasta= dFecH
		Thisform.Id_Moneda = cId_Moneda
		Thisform.Opcion = lOpcion
		
		Thisform.oTblCentroCostos.Buscar(cId_CCosto,.f.,"Clave")
		Thisform.oTblCtasContables.Buscar(cId_CtaContable,.f.,"Clave")
		
		ThisForm.oLblCCosto.Caption = Alltrim(Thisform.oTblCentroCostos.Leer("Nombre")) + " (" +cId_CCosto + ")"
		ThisForm.oLblCtaContable.Caption =Alltrim(Thisform.oTblCtasContables.Leer("Nombre")) + " (" + cId_CtaContable + ")"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		
		Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Refrescar(cId_CCosto,dFecD,dFecH,cId_Moneda,lOpcion,,cId_CtaContable)
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE escobranza
		LParameters cID_Comproba
		ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE espago
		LParameters cId_Comproba
		ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("Pago")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_CCosto,cId_CtaContable,dFecd,dFecH,cId_Moneda,lOpcion,lOcultar
		
		DoDefault()
		
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCentroCostos","Tg_Tabla","CentroCostos","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCtasContables","Tg_Tabla","CtasContables","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntCentrosCostos","Tg_ViewCntCentrosCostos")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Cmp_Docu","Clave")
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(6,7)
		
		This.Consultar(cId_CCosto,cId_CtaContable,dFecd,dFecH,cId_Moneda,lOpcion,lOcultar)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar,cId_sistemaLlamador
		
		cId_comproba    =	Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Leer("Id_Comproba")
		nNro_Referencia	=	Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Leer("Nro_Referencia")
		cId_sucursal		=	Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Leer("Id_Sucursal")
		cId_sistema			=	Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Leer("Id_Sistema")
		cId_sistemaLlamador=oApp.CodSistema("Contabilidad")
		lOcultar=.T.
		Do Case
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")
			  If ThisForm.EsCobranza(cId_Comproba)
			 		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
				Else	  
			  	If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
				Endif
			Case CId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Compras")
				If ThisForm.EsPago(cId_Comproba)	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
				Else	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
				Endif	
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Banco")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos","TG_ConsCompBanco",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.ConsultarCompBanco(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.Show()
				
			Case cId_sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Caja")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()
		
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Cobradores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores","TG_ConsCompCobradores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.ConsultarCompCobradores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.Show()
				
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores","TG_ConsCompVendedores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.ConsultarCompVendedores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.Show()
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Stock")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock","TG_ConsCompStock",cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.ConsultarCompStock(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
			
		EndCase
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescaraplicacion
		 
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Refrescar(Thisform.Id_CCosto,Thisform.FechaDesde,Thisform.FechaHasta,Thisform.Id_Moneda,Thisform.Opcion,,Thisform.Id_CtaContable)
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla()
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		Thisform.LockScreen = .t.
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Id_Sucursal"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Id_Sistema"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Id_Comproba"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Nro_Referencia"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".Fecha"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".ImpDebe"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column7.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".ImpHaber"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column8.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntCentrosCostos.Alias + ".ImpSaldo"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen = .f.
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		Thisform.Hide
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_grid1.dblclickencelda
		Thisform.MostrarComprobante
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE escobranza

		Return ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("Pago")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar
		DoDefault()
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblSub_Errores","Tg_Tabla","Sub_Errores","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","Tg_Tabla","Monedas","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblSucursales","Tg_Tabla","Sucursales","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Cmp_Docu","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		
		Thisform.SetearConsulta(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar)
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar,cId_sistemaLlamador
		
		cId_comproba    =	ThisForm.Id_Comproba
		nNro_Referencia	=	ThisForm.Nro_Referencia
		cId_sucursal		=	ThisForm.Id_Sucursal
		cId_sistema			=	ThisForm.Id_Sistema
		
		cId_sistemaLlamador=oApp.CodSistema("Contabilidad")
		lOcultar=.T.
		
		Do Case
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")
			  If ThisForm.EsCobranza(cId_Comproba)
			 		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
				Else	  
			  	If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
				Endif
			Case CId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Compras")
				If ThisForm.EsPago(cId_Comproba)	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
				Else	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
				Endif	
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Banco")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos","TG_ConsCompBanco",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.ConsultarCompBanco(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.Show()
				
			Case cId_sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Caja")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()
		
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Cobradores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores","TG_ConsCompCobradores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.ConsultarCompCobradores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.Show()
				
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores","TG_ConsCompVendedores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.ConsultarCompVendedores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.Show()
				
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Stock")	
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock","TG_ConsCompStock",cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.ConsultarCompStock(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.Show()
				
		EndCase
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarsubasientoerroneo
		Local cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar,cId_sistemaLlamador
		
		cId_comproba    =	ThisForm.Id_Comproba
		nNro_Referencia	=	ThisForm.Nro_Referencia
		cId_sucursal		=	ThisForm.Id_Sucursal
		cId_sistema			=	ThisForm.Id_Sistema
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmAsientoErroneo")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmAsientoErroneo","Tg_ConsultaSubAsientoErroneo",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmAsientoErroneo.Consultar(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		Thisform.oFrmAsientoErroneo.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE presentartexto
		LParameters cMensaje
		Return Strtran(cMensaje, "<->", Chr(13))
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If !thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar
		
		thisform.Ocultar=lOcultar
		Thisform.Id_Sucursal		=	cId_Sucursal
		Thisform.Id_Sistema			=	cId_Sistema
		Thisform.Id_Comproba		=	cId_Comproba
		Thisform.Nro_Referencia =	nNro_Referencia
		
		Thisform.oTblSucursales.Buscar(cId_Sucursal,.f.,"Clave")
		ThisForm.oTbxSurcursal.Value=Thisform.oTblSucursales.Leer("Nombre")
		
		ThisForm.oTbxComprobante.Value=oApp.ConsultarNombreComprobante(cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba)
		ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value=nNro_Referencia
		
		Thisform.oTblSub_Errores.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"Clave")
		ThisForm.oTbxTotal.Value=ThisForm.oTblSub_Errores.Leer("Total")
		ThisForm.oEdbMensaje.Value=Thisform.PresentarTexto(ThisForm.oTblSub_Errores.Leer("Observaciones"))
		
		Thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(ThisForm.oTblSub_Errores.Leer("Id_Moneda"),.f.,"Clave")
		ThisForm.oTbxMoneda.Value=Thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdAsientoErroneo.Click
		ThisForm.MostrarSubAsientoErroneo()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		If thisform.Ocultar
			thisform.release
		Else
			thisform.Hide
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDatos.Click
		Thisform.Mostrarcomprobante()
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE escobranza
		LParameters cID_Comproba
		ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblVnt_Docu.Leer("Cobranza")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE espago
		LParameters cId_Comproba
		ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Buscar(cID_Comproba,.f.,"Clave")
		Return ThisForm.oTblCmp_Docu.Leer("Pago")
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar
		DoDefault()
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblSub_Errores","Tg_Tabla","Sub_Errores","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblMonedas","Tg_Tabla","Monedas","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblSucursales","Tg_Tabla","Sucursales","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblCmp_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Cmp_Docu","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblVnt_Docu","Tg_Tabla","Vnt_Docu","Clave")
		
		Thisform.SetearConsulta(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar)
		
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarcomprobante
		Local cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar,cId_sistemaLlamador
		
		cId_comproba    =	ThisForm.Id_Comproba
		nNro_Referencia	=	ThisForm.Nro_Referencia
		cId_sucursal		=	ThisForm.Id_Sucursal
		cId_sistema			=	ThisForm.Id_Sistema
		
		cId_sistemaLlamador=oApp.CodSistema("Contabilidad")
		lOcultar=.T.
		
		Do Case
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Ventas")
			  If ThisForm.EsCobranza(cId_Comproba)
			 		If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza","TG_ConsultaCobranza",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.ConsultarCobranza(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaCobranza.Show()
				Else	  
			  	If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante","TG_ConsultaComprobante",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobante.Show()
				Endif
			Case CId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Compras")
				If ThisForm.EsPago(cId_Comproba)	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaPago","TG_ConsultaPago",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.ConsultarPago(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaPago.Show()
				Else	
					If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras")<>T_OBJECT			 
						thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras","TG_ConsCompCompras",cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)				
						thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
					Else
						Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.ConsultarComprobante(cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,.t.,cId_sistemaLlamador)			
					Endif	
					thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCompras.Show()
				Endif	
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Banco")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos","TG_ConsCompBanco",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.ConsultarCompBanco(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteBancos.Show()
				
			Case cId_sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Caja")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja","TG_ConsCompCaja",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.ConsultarCompCaja(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCaja.Show()
		
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Cobradores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores","TG_ConsCompCobradores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.ConsultarCompCobradores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteCobradores.Show()
				
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Vendedores")
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores","TG_ConsCompVendedores",cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.ConsultarCompVendedores(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteVendedores.Show()
				
			Case cId_Sistema=oApp.CodSistema("Stock")	
				If Type("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock")<>T_OBJECT			 
					thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock","TG_ConsCompStock",cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
				Else
					Thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.ConsultarCompStock(cId_Sucursal,cId_sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
				Endif	
				thisform.oFrmConsultaComprobanteStock.Show()
				
		EndCase
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE mostrarsubasientoerroneo
		Local cId_comprobante,nReferencia,cId_sucursal,cId_sistema,lOcultar,cId_sistemaLlamador
		
		cId_comproba    =	ThisForm.Id_Comproba
		nNro_Referencia	=	ThisForm.Nro_Referencia
		cId_sucursal		=	ThisForm.Id_Sucursal
		cId_sistema			=	ThisForm.Id_Sistema
		
		If Type("thisform.oFrmAsientoErroneo")<>T_OBJECT			 
			thisform.CrearYAsignarObjeto("thisform.oFrmAsientoErroneo","Tg_ConsultaSubAsientoErroneo",cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)				
		Else
			Thisform.oFrmAsientoErroneo.Consultar(cId_sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,.t.)			
		Endif	
		
		Thisform.oFrmAsientoErroneo.Show()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE presentartexto
		LParameters cMensaje
		Return Strtran(cMensaje, "<->", Chr(13))
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If !thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE setearconsulta
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar
		
		thisform.Ocultar=lOcultar
		Thisform.Id_Sucursal		=	cId_Sucursal
		Thisform.Id_Sistema			=	cId_Sistema
		Thisform.Id_Comproba		=	cId_Comproba
		Thisform.Nro_Referencia =	nNro_Referencia
		
		Thisform.oTblSucursales.Buscar(cId_Sucursal,.f.,"Clave")
		ThisForm.oTbxSurcursal.Value=Thisform.oTblSucursales.Leer("Nombre")
		
		ThisForm.oTbxComprobante.Value=oApp.ConsultarNombreComprobante(cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba)
		ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value=nNro_Referencia
		
		Thisform.oTblSub_Errores.Buscar(cId_Sucursal+cId_Sistema+cId_Comproba+Str(nNro_Referencia,10),.f.,"Clave")
		ThisForm.oTbxTotal.Value=ThisForm.oTblSub_Errores.Leer("Total")
		ThisForm.oEdbMensaje.Value=Thisform.PresentarTexto(ThisForm.oTblSub_Errores.Leer("Observaciones"))
		
		Thisform.oTblMonedas.Buscar(ThisForm.oTblSub_Errores.Leer("Id_Moneda"),.f.,"Clave")
		ThisForm.oTbxMoneda.Value=Thisform.oTblMonedas.Leer("Nombre")
		
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdAsientoErroneo.Click
		ThisForm.MostrarSubAsientoErroneo()
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdCerrar.Click
		If thisform.Ocultar
			thisform.release
		Else
			thisform.Hide
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE oCmdDatos.Click
		Thisform.Mostrarcomprobante()
		
		
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE consultar
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar
		
		thisform.Ocultar=lOcultar
		Thisform.Id_Sucursal		=	cId_Sucursal
		Thisform.Id_Sistema			=	cId_Sistema
		Thisform.Id_Comproba		=	cId_Comproba
		Thisform.Nro_Referencia =	nNro_Referencia
		
		
		Thisform.oTblSucursales.Buscar(cId_Sucursal,.f.,"Clave")
		ThisForm.oTbxSurcursal.Value=Thisform.oTblSucursales.Leer("Nombre")
		
		ThisForm.oTbxComprobante.Value=oApp.ConsultarNombreComprobante(cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba)
		ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value=nNro_Referencia
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar
		DoDefault()
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblSucursales","Tg_Tabla","Sucursales","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos","tg_viewcntsub_asientoserroneos")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(3,4)
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.CurrentControl="Tg_checkbox1"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.Tg_checkbox1.Enabled=.f.
		Thisform.Consultar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia
		
		
		Thisform.lockScreen=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".Id_CtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".NomCtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".MonDebe"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".MonHaber"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".Defecto"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".NomPosicion"
		
		** SERGIO 02/05/2023 # 1603
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.InputMask = "99,999,999,999.99"
		** SERGIO 02/05/2023 # 1603
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		If thisform.Ocultar
			thisform.Hide	
		Else
			thisform.release
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

	PROCEDURE consultar
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar
		
		thisform.Ocultar=lOcultar
		Thisform.Id_Sucursal		=	cId_Sucursal
		Thisform.Id_Sistema			=	cId_Sistema
		Thisform.Id_Comproba		=	cId_Comproba
		Thisform.Nro_Referencia =	nNro_Referencia
		
		
		Thisform.oTblSucursales.Buscar(cId_Sucursal,.f.,"Clave")
		ThisForm.oTbxSurcursal.Value=Thisform.oTblSucursales.Leer("Nombre")
		
		ThisForm.oTbxComprobante.Value=oApp.ConsultarNombreComprobante(cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba)
		ThisForm.oTbxNumero.Value=nNro_Referencia
		
		Thisform.RefrescarGrilla(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Init
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar
		DoDefault()
		Thisform.AddObject("oTblSucursales","Tg_Tabla","Sucursales","Clave")
		Thisform.AddObject("oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos","tg_viewcntsub_asientoserroneos")
		
		thisform.tg_grid1.ResaltarRenglon(3,4)
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.CurrentControl="Tg_checkbox1"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.Tg_checkbox1.Enabled=.f.
		Thisform.Consultar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia,lOcultar)
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE QueryUnload
		Local lRetorna
		lRetorna=dodefault()
		If thisform.Ocultar.and.thisform.ReleaseType=1
			Nodefault	
			lRetorna=.f.
			thisform.Hide
		Endif
		
		Return lRetorna
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE refrescargrilla
		LParameters cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia
		
		
		Thisform.lockScreen=.t.
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=""
		
		Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Refrescar(cId_Sucursal,cId_Sistema,cId_Comproba,nNro_Referencia)
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSourceType=1
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.RecordSource=Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column1.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".Id_CtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column2.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".NomCtaContable"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column3.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".MonDebe"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column4.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".MonHaber"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column5.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".Defecto"
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Column6.ControlSource= Thisform.oViewCntSub_AsientosErroneos.Alias + ".NomPosicion"
		
		ThisForm.Tg_grid1.Refresh()
		
		Thisform.LockScreen=.f.
		
	ENDPROC

	PROCEDURE Tg_btnaceptar1.Click
		If thisform.Ocultar
			thisform.Hide	
		Else
			thisform.release
		Endif	
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE

DEFINE CLASS tg_seleccionarcomprobantescontabilidad AS tg_lstselevariositems OF "tg_varios.vcx" 
 	*< CLASSDATA: Baseclass="container" Timestamp="" Scale="Pixels" Uniqueid="" />

	#INCLUDE "..\include\target.h"
	*<PropValue>
		Name = "tg_seleccionarcomprobantescontabilidad"
		Tg_listbox1.ColumnWidths = "15,30,190,60"
		Tg_listbox1.Name = "Tg_listbox1"
		Tg_3dshape1.Name = "Tg_3dshape1"
		oChkMarcaTodo.Name = "oChkMarcaTodo"
		Tg_label1.Caption = "Asientos Tipo"
		Tg_label1.Name = "Tg_label1"
	*</PropValue>
	
	PROCEDURE Init
		lParameters cFiltro,lMarcarTodo
		Local mmpp
		mmpp=0
		dodefault()
		this.AddObject("oTblCnt_Docu","Tg_tabla","Cnt_Docu","Clave")
		
		If Type("cFiltro")=T_CHARACTER
			this.oTblCnt_Docu.Filtrar(cFiltro)
		Endif
		
		IF This.oTblParametros.Leer("OrdenNombreSelccionComprobantes")
			this.oTblCnt_Docu.FijarTag("Nombre")
		Endif
		
		
		
		
		Do while !this.oTblCnt_Docu.EsEof()
			If oApp.PedirPermiso("COM",this.oTblCnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")	,"C" ,oApp.CodSistema("Contabilidad")) or !this.FiltraComprobantesEnConsultasPorPermisos
		
				mmpp=mmpp+1
				this.tg_listbox1.AddItem(space(5),mmpp,1)
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,2)=this.oTblCnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,3)=this.oTblCnt_Docu.Leer("Nombre")
				this.tg_listbox1.List(mmpp,4)=""
					
				Dimension this.vItems[mmpp,2]
				this.vItems[mmpp,1]=this.oTblCnt_Docu.Leer("id_comproba")
				this.vItems[mmpp,2]=.f.
			Endif
			
			this.oTblCnt_Docu.IrSiguiente
			
		Enddo
		
		
		this.tg_listbox1.Listindex=1
		If lMarcarTodo
			this.MarcarTodo
		Endif
	ENDPROC

ENDDEFINE
